themes.label: Redesign hides meal items, adds clicks
themes.summary: Long-time users across iOS and Android say the recent redesign broke their daily food diary workflow. They can no longer see all logged foods for the day on one screen, must tap into each meal separately, and face extra taps to log food, copy meals, or delete multiple items. Several mention they are considering switching apps or reverting to an older version, and some ask for the old layout or a toggle to restore it.
themes.recommendation: Run a usability study comparing the old and new diary home screens on the current app version, then ship a feature flag or settings toggle that restores the single-screen daily food list with visible meal items and multi-select delete and copy.

themes.label: Backlash against redesigned UI layout
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android are angry that a recent redesign made common tasks like logging food, viewing daily entries, and moving items between meals take more taps, scrolling, and screens. Many explicitly ask for the previous layout to be restored, and several say they are switching to competitors or cancelling. Some long-time users mention losing streaks or feeling owed a refund for a subscription bought on the old layout.
themes.recommendation: Pull usage and drop-off data for the redesigned daily log and meal-move flows versus the prior version, identify the steps that added the most taps, and evaluate offering an opt-in classic layout toggle while the team decides on a fix.

themes.label: Redesigned diary UI hurts logging
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS say a recent redesign split the diary into separate meal sections, so they can no longer see total and remaining calories, macros, and all logged foods on one screen. Many describe extra taps for logging and deleting entries, small or faint calorie figures, and accidental copying of prior meals, and several say they are switching to other apps. Recurring versions named include v26.14.0 through v26.39.0, and many ask for a way to revert to the old interface.
themes.recommendation: Run a usability study comparing the old and current diary flows, measuring taps to log a food and to view daily calorie totals, then ship a settings toggle that restores a single-screen daily diary with remaining calories and meal totals visible.

themes.label: Premium paywall and intrusive ads
themes.summary: Users across iOS and Android say the app has moved core features like barcode scanning and search behind Premium, with prices they consider excessive (often $10 to $30 per month or $120 per year). Many also report constant full-page or unskippable ads and repeated upgrade prompts during basic logging, and several say they are switching to competitors or cancelling.
themes.recommendation: Audit which free features were moved behind Premium since v22 (starting with barcode scanning and data export) and run an A/B test on ad frequency and upgrade-prompt cadence in logging flows, tracking churn and uninstall rate per variant.

themes.label: Redesigned UI makes logging slower
themes.summary: Long-time users across Android and iOS say the latest layout changes made food and meal logging slower, with more taps to reach logging, water, and nutrient totals. Several reviewers say features they relied on, such as copying a day's log or a meal, were removed or buried in sub-menus, and some describe the app as a regression from earlier versions. Many also tie the frustration to paywalled barcode scanning and premium upsells, which they feel compound the usability problems.
themes.recommendation: Run a usability study comparing the current logging flow against the prior version, measuring taps and time to log a meal, water, and daily totals, then restore one-tap access to copy a day's log or individual meals and make the default nutrition view daily.

themes.label: Random logouts and lost login
themes.summary: Many long-time users report being logged out repeatedly, often mid-task or right after opening the app, and then unable to log back in because passwords reset or fail, sometimes with account data wiped. Several Android and iOS users on recent versions (v26.x) describe this as ongoing for weeks, and some paying subscribers say support has not resolved it.
themes.recommendation: Investigate session token expiry and credential storage across v26.x on Android and iOS by pulling crash and auth logs for forced logouts and failed password resets, then ship a fix and confirm that password reset emails are delivered reliably.

themes.label: Barcode scanner moved to paywall
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS, spanning reviews from 2022 to 2026, are angry that barcode scanning, once free, now requires a premium subscription (often cited as about $20 a month). Many say they are uninstalling or switching to free competitors, and some add complaints about ads, inaccurate nutrition data from scans, or sync problems.
themes.recommendation: Pull scanner-related paywall conversion and churn data by platform and app version, and evaluate restoring free barcode scanning (perhaps with a daily or monthly limit) while testing whether the premium tier is better differentiated by other features.

themes.label: Health app sync failures and duplicates
themes.summary: Users across Android and iOS report that wearables and fitness sources (Fitbit, Samsung Health, Apple Health, MapMyWalk, Health Connect) stop syncing steps and workouts after recent app updates, or sync incorrectly by duplicating or missing entries. Several also describe calorie goals resetting or inflating after syncs fail, and many tie the breakage to a new dashboard or format introduced in the v26.x releases.
themes.recommendation: Audit the v26.14 to v26.36 release notes and sync pipelines for Health Connect, Samsung Health, Apple Health, Fitbit and MapMyFitness, and add deduplication keyed on source workout ID so repeated syncs cannot create duplicate entries; ship a manual step-entry fallback as a stopgap.

themes.label: Confusing, cluttered interface and paywalls
themes.summary: Users in this mixed cluster complain that the app is hard to learn and cluttered, with some citing the day labels being wrong (tomorrow shown as today, yesterday shown as tomorrow) on recent iOS versions, and others objecting to paid features like barcode scanning and frequent subscription prompts. A few older reviews mention eating-disorder concerns and ads, and several French reviews prefer the previous layout, suggesting the redesign is a major source of friction.
themes.recommendation: Investigate the iOS date-label bug in the weekly/diary view across v25.37.1 to v26.42.0 and ship a fix, then run a usability test on the redesigned diary layout with new users to identify where they get lost.

I used this app religiously for over a decade and never questioned paying for premium. The updates from last autumn completely killed it! I used to track everything nutritional here and export to other apps, but I've settled for logging directly into multiple mediocre apps instead. MyFitnessPal is a heartbreaking disappointment. Don't waste your time or money.

I used to love the app, and I use it religiously everyday. The new updates add complexity and are not user friendly. It’s harder, and sometimes the option is not available, to simply copy meals; which makes tracking more time consuming. It’s also harder to see the daily totals (need to scroll up vs it being on the screen). The app now adds more friction to everyday life as a consumer. As a coach, it was hard enough to get clients to track nutrition; the new update gives that objection/resistance much more validity. Please bring back the old diary layout.

Ad depented calorie counter. I have used this app off and on over 14 years. In the beginning, you could scan the barcode of an item and add it. It would tell you your daily intake of fats and sugars and vitamins. Now, you need an auxiliary app to scan barcodes, and it only shows carbs, fats, and proteins unless you navigate to one of its sub menus, using one of the clunkiest interfaces I have seen. All while pushing premium subscription and alternative apps to " Enhance" your experience it.

I saw another person had this problem but tried out their trial, canceled before it was over cuz I was NOT paying $120.74 for just being able to scan my meal and barcode scan when it wouldn’t be at least 70-80% accurate, you were still filling everything out manually, but whatever, okay, triple checked my subscriptions, I canceled, a month later was charged that 120, requested a refund, they wanted more info just to refuse

edit: fast response by developers resolved this issue! I have used this app daily for over 2 years and have been successful with my goals. Lately my custom goals have been changing without notice. Please fix this… I should not have to reset my goals every time I open the app! Please add an option to include a full day (24 hours) of fasting so the day count doesn’t reset.

I am forced to use this to log food in my Withings app. If I would have known this I would have gone with a different scale. This app is insanely priced compared to others. It's full of ads and the calorie counts are wrong. you can't type in Costco or Starbucks to find foods. So I'm going to keep using mynetdiary, and manually put the food into myfitnesspal. Two foods in both apps myfitnesspal has the wrong count.

I don't know why, but sometimes this app syncs with my Samsung smartwatch and counts every exercise twice. some days, it doesn't count the exercise at all. there's no manual way to force it to sync. this is unusable and I don't recommend it to anybody
The app was great and convenient but now if you want to scan a barcode for convenience you have to pay the outrageous monthly fee. A huge L from the money grubbing MyFitnessPal

Great app with a huge food database and excellent Garmin sync. However, it misses a few basic features: 1) Let me copy a single food item from a previous day instead of a whole meal. 2) Recipe duplication should work in the mobile app, not only on the web. 3) Meal Scan needs more accurate portion estimates. Fix these and this would easily be a 5-star app.
App used to be good, now has annoying ads and a streak counter, theyre trying to gamify it but its done very poorly. I would rather the old myfittnesspal with less features than this.

I have been using this app for more than 10 years… whatever recent updates they have been making are TERRIBLE. Not user friendly at all and makes tracking not fun anymore. I hope you switch it back. This used to be my favourite tracking app and now I don’t even want to use it anymore.

The app works fine, is realitivly user friendly and has a lot of things on it. however it's riddled with adds, often has nutritional information not matching what your using, and or it's impossible to find your item. So much so that the app has made me want to quite the diet numerous times. While three free versions perfectly accessible, it's malicious in it's attempt to get you to buy the $29/ month premium... which is what you'll need for the scan btw.

I've just recently returned to tracking, and while there have been some minor improvements, it feels like most of the page is now ads. I can't see at a glance what I've tracked already without clicking into each mealtime. It's also easy to think you've tracked a meal only to realise it's showing yesterday's meal (in case you want to add it again) - they look similar and there's just not enough room under each mealtime now. I'm almost done with this app, it's no longer fit for purpose.

I used to love this app. I've been using it off & on for over a decade. Now that the newsfeed is gone, it's no better than any other calorie tracking app. This change is an epic fail. 2026.. it's gotten worse!! now it's so much more complicated to input food. I'm going to start trying to log directly through my FitBit app instead. shame Ive been using this for over a decade & now It's awful.

I liked the old version not the new updated version. it's hard to see everything because everything is separate where before it was together. for example: your food and exercise would show separate but in the same column. so you could tell how many calories you have eaten before the amount of calories you've burned would be calculated.

it's just ok. I'm not going to pay for this, the price is insane. I only use it to count calories and protein. What is annoying about this app? Most prepackaged foods are not available on here or hard to find when I search them - Or, f they are available they will have several listed and they all have different calories and macros for the exact same product or item. Random people must be putting them in wrong.
Logged me out and unable to log me back in again via Facebook login. Please fix your app.

reviews.t: Suddenly there’s no foods on App
reviews.x: Can’t add anything from searching as there’s nothing for anything I search.

After the last update I'm no longer able to search for the foods through the extensive library. I used to be able to do this and now with the free version no matter what food I put in it tells me no search results available. super disappointed because this was a really good app.

App has become entirely unusable and seems to have spontaneously forgotten my account, now I can't log in or use it. It seems they've also locked the barcode scanner behind a pay wall, which definitely puts me off using it even if I do manage to regain access to my account! I used to recommend this to my friends, but I'll be warning them all to avoid now.

Can't add anything that I haven't previously saved as a meal. Any time i search for another food, I get a "network error, please try again later" message. Meanwhile the exercises STILL don't sort by most recent, despite developer saying they're working on it months ago.

I used to like this app. They continue to be more restrictive on the foods you find in the free version to log in your diary. Essentially trying to force you to pay for a version you don't want or need. All I want are the basics, and now that is becoming limited. Time to search for a new app to track my food diary.

I’m experiencing a lot of issues with the watch. It only worked properly the first time after it was installed. Since then, it hasn’t synced with the phone data at all. Retrieving logs from the watch is also very slow, and sometimes it doesn’t work either. Overall, this has been a very disappointing experience, especially considering that I’m paying for the premium subscription.

This redesign is a huge step backward. I’ve never seen an update remove so much useful functionality while making basic tasks take longer. The new layout is cluttered and inefficient. The Diary was the heart of the app, but now it’s buried behind extra taps. I can no longer see my entire day’s meals at a glance, editing and copying foods has become frustrating, and simple tasks that used to take one tap now require several. The oversized cards waste screen space, and important information like calories, macros, and exercise is much harder to find. It feels like the redesign prioritized AI features, streaks, and visual changes over the needs of people who actually use this app every day to track nutrition.

Generally works ok but will randomly log me out. This morning I logged one food item for breakfast then a second later it logged me out before I could add the rest. Will be randomly logged out every week-month with seemingly no pattern. Also disappointed by inconsistency compared to the mobile site, eg. no ability to "quick add" calories, and won't give weight forecast for less than 1500 calories per day (my target) but mobile site has minimum set to 1200.

Overall a better app than Cronometer and less bugs as well. I would prefer MFP tracked micros and didn't require a food to be logged (Like Cronometer) as breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack. The latter is really a waste of time and forced rigidity. There should be an opt out of this anachronistic way of eating.

reviews.t: Paid for one year subscription stopped working after one month
reviews.x: I payed for one year and it still shows up in my app store that i have an active subscription with my fitness pal. But on my fitness pal it is saying to resubscribe. This is the same account I registered with as-well. I know since all the data Ive been using since my premium account was cancelled in still there.
Cant even scan anymore. Making something that used to be a free a premium charge is scummy.

The most common complaint you see everywhere on the internet with MFP...they offer integration with third party apps to sync weigh ins from connected scales...however - none of it seems to work. Or if it works, it doesn't work consistently. Zero support from MFP on this other than an unhelpful FAQ.

I've been using MFP for over a decade now. The latest UI is awful. 1). accidentally clicking the log yesterdays meal is too easy, and then having to manually click each item to delete it is time consuming. 2) the popup that takes up the whole screen saying yay X number of days streak, every day, is patronizing and feels like they are talking to a toddler. and it keeps me from making the change I need to make. at least have an option to turn it off. I already submitted an MFP ticket.

The latest update does not synchronize your calorie goal with the home menu. i set 1500 as a goal but the main menu shows 2035. makes no sense. EDIT: Issue persists. I can upload images of the issue if needed EDIT: i am putting a 4/5. turns out the app was tracking ny calories burned through Samsung Health on my watch. suggestion: keep my original goal and in patenthesis the exercise-adjusted goal or vice versa. the one with the 🔥 emoji.

Can you please remove the streak notification and bring it back to what it used to be at the top? I fill out my food and it’s very annoying - like an add you have to cancel out of. Amazing app otherwise!!!!!

I loved the old version of the app -- it was simple, straightforward, and had everything a user needed. The new version is inundated with ads, does not allow you to view your meals as a whole, and miscalculates macros. It seems like the company destroyed the app for the sake of ad space.

The app is really making a difference. A few tiny glitches, on occasion, are so worth working through. And the Ai coach is helpful. Losing weight is a bonus, helping me focus on healthy lifestyle choices is invaluable.

Bug in meal creating function and lots of wrong entries. When adding items to a meal, a bug causes the entire meal list to be replaced with the most recent addition. I've lost carefully curated meal lists due to this which is frustrating and time consuming. Also, so many wrong entries. There should be a voting/thumbs up option for entries so users can push the globally agreed correct ones to the top of the list. Many of the entries need to be deleted and cleaned up - don't be lazy.

I'm not a fan of this new version in general, after using my fitness pal premium version for years. Things are counterintuitive to locate, And I find myself using other apps that are just frankly easier. I also hate on the micro tracking that the columns are now average /goal/left... I only want to see goal/left... That average column is just added noise on an already crowded page
I would tread carefully if you want to retain customers in the near future.

Kind of a load of nonsense that you have to pay for the premium just for the barcode scanning function.... especially when other apps have it for free. I'd prefer to use this as my one stop all things calorie counting (activity, food, etc.) but not about to pay for a different version. 🙄

This app has completely went downhill in the last few months. One MAJOR thing that's been happening for me is when I log my pre-saved meals, some of the individual ingredients will change to 0 cals. So I've been overeating by a lot every day before I realized it started doing this, thanks to the last update. The main purpose of the app is to log calories and it can't even do that correctly. It used to be perfect, but it's been ruined. Save your time and do not bother.

Errors with calories burned in past days. It increases to a greater number of calories burned each day when looking at it in reverse. Not accurate. This is some error which occurs while syncing to Google Fit via Android Health Connect to import steps and calories burned... which seems very base level. I just want to give this 5 stars but the issue is unfortunate so 4 stars for now.

I feel like this app still doesnt incorporate weights or estimated calories burned with it. The most annoying is that the app doesnt sync to your fitbit (google health) even if it says its connected. Ive literally logged in disconnected and reconnected the app, etc. and it STILL doesnt migrate my steps over. its annoying and frustrating and makes me not want to keep this app. Please, fix this. This is a fitness app and its not even properly working. also, stop making everything Premium.

i like this app, the free version gives me everything i need. my one wish, is that for quick add entries, i wish i could name the entry or leave a note. sometimes quick add when i know the calorie amount is more efficient than searching for existing foods that aren't in the app or the nutrition info is wrong. i'd want to write down what it was i ate in the quick add entry.

I do like it overall, but every time I type out food to log, my letters suddenly get moved around to the front of the text box so I have to retype the food I was trying to log. I hope this gets fixed as it does it at least twice a day

I used to think this was an amazing app but now it's just ok. Putting one of the best features (the barcode scanner) behind a paywall is absolute BS! Loyal fans now have to pay $20 a month just to be able to scan food barcodes in order to post it to our Diary. These people used to care about making it as easy as possible for people to keep up on our Diaries, now it seems like they only care about $$$. I'll keep using it until I find an app that's better... one that isn't greedy.
Terrible

The app logged me out of my account and deleted all my recipes. Can’t talk to anyone from support cause it is AI. The AI tells you to hang on tight while they see if they can recover your recipes, and a minute later says it’s not understanding your question and asks for a review of how good the support was.
I paid when I registered in this app but after that when I went to prepare me. It asked me to pay again for premium. I cannot pay this many times.

reviews.t: Free version getting worse and worse
reviews.x: I don’t know what’s changed recently but the app is continuously signing me out multiple times a day. Ads are relentless now to the point where they pop up in the middle of me logging my food and taking up the entire screen almost every single meal. Calories/macro targets randomly reset out of nowhere, and you can no longer turn off exercise calories for free. I refuse to pay for the premium version, if this continues or gets worse I will be switching platforms altogether.
No diary sucks

Great way to monitor what you eat daily, weekly etc. The free version is adequate for the basic calories, nutrients, goals; the premium has a lot more in depth features - pretty cool. The extra bells and whistles are beyond my budget right now. That's OK cuz the basic, free version is perfect for me. I have a hard time sticking with my best intentions and this is proving to be a good way to set up healthy habits and create an ongoing plan to meet consistent nutrition goals.

reviews.t: Do you want to buy premium?
reviews.x: Couldn’t even finish logging my breakfast and it asked me 3 times if I wanted to buy premium. I haven’t been using the app 10 minutes you guys gotta chill

I’ve been using this app since 2021. It was an amazing app, you could check everything; macros, sugar, fats... But now we have to pay to check the most basic thing as our macros? What the heck! So sad…

prefer usability prior to recent update. Easily add/move foods to different days. Current process isn't as effective. Mobile app not as easy as it was. pressing buttons i don't want as close to the 'log yesterday meal' button I accidentally push. Prefer a tab for diary log like prior. Barcode scan prompt too intrusive over screen and premium banner.

The latest update is awful and has ruined the calories in/out feature. As soon as you log food, the remaining calories available resets to a number that makes no sense e.g. if your goal is consuming 1500 calories/day, logging breakfast will drop the total calories consumed to below 1000 and activity doesn’t seem to help it. The old tile worked just fine and now this function is totally useless - will be switching to a better app.

I haven't used MyFitnessPal in a couple of years, but wanted to try it again. Unfortunately, it lasted less than 24 hours on my phone. Not being able to use the barcode scanner unless you're paying the premium service is a deal-breaker and quite ridiculous. The barcode scanner has been part of MyFitnessPal forever. There must be plenty of people out there willing to pay for that feature but I am not one of them.
Periodically and randomly signs me out and makes me sign back in and then kicks me out again. will do repeatedly until I leave it for while and try again.

overall very useful and works so well, especially compared to other. there are a few issues. 1 when you scan a barcode and the nutritional info and portion size is wrong, it lets you submit new nutritional info but not a new portion size, so you just have to create a whole new one. 2 when trying to setup the meal plans it won't let me proceed without reviewing 5 recipes, but it shows me no recipes instead just a sign saying I've reviewed them - I can't use the meal plan area as premium payer.

reviews.t: App logged me out after update and data and log were gone this was quite annoying.
reviews.x: App logged me out after update and data and logs were gone this was quite annoying.
Kinda painful to use. I typed in ‘scrambled eggs’ it didn’t recognize it as a food.

Update: Now the app logs me out randomly. Getting closer to unusable. Just don't sign up for their premium, because even if you recieve a refund on what should've been a cancelled subscription (before the renew date), you'll still get a retry charge 2 weeks later. Support will also say "sorry, can't help you". The app used to be less buggy, but food entries water logs get deleted randomly. Inconsistent tracking on 4 out of 7 days. So stay on top of it, and I guess you'll be fine.

For all its flaws, I still use it for tracking calories and macronutrients. It has a large bank updated by users - so be careful with confirming foods. It has some good charts. Integrations are unreliable (e.g. Strava import). Menus are hidden behind multiple clicks e.g. finding the weight progress menu can be a chore. The app keeps adding "improvements" that make it harder to use e.g. clicking through multiple screens to get to the place to log a meal or water.

App sucks now. It's gotten more and more bloated over the years, I hate the annoying streak pop-ups every single day you log. Also the app has a bunch of weird, annoying bugs, like the weight graph starting on the current day and just showing a straight line into the future. Very often when I relog a meal from the previous day, it will add twice. It kind of feels like the app is vibe-coded which sucks.

reviews.t: Was once fantastic, now useless garbage.
reviews.x: I once swore by this app. No more, I’ll now promote any other app. The greed and ineptitude of those responsible for this nosedive, have destroyed what was once useful.

reviews.t: Charging for barcode scanner now ~ seriously?
reviews.x: This app was fantastic prior to Under Armour buying it out. The community has become sloppy & difficult to navigate . It is also congested with very old data. Forcing people to pay for premium to use the barcode scanner is disappointing and uncommon. There are plenty of streamlined diet & fitness apps out there that do not charge for the bare minimum.

I know this sounds a bit dramatic, but this app changed the way I look at food and my overall health. I’m a very active person, and didn’t realise how much of a calorie deficit I’ve been in for awhile. I’ve been using the app for about two months, and the physical changes are absolutely insane. 11/10
You can no longer see the breakdown per meal, with all the details. Viewing your diary shows every food in the day.

Forces you to share your data, also you used to be able to use the barcode scanner in the free app and now you have to pay for it. Hidden charges everywhere. I also had to create a whole new account cause I could no longer access my old one.
When I go to input breakfast, it shows every meal and snacks on the breakfast page. This only started happening with the latest update. Please fix, I love this app and use it everyday

Ive been using this app everyday for months and paid over $100 for premium features, now when I open the app it says my account is not found and to create a new one. This app is a scam that just stole my money.

10+ years using this app and ive always loved it until the most recent update. It is not user friendly at all. Requires more clicks for basic things. I am most frustrated but it glitching and being unable to tell me the accurate number of macros ive logged for the day. One spot says 174 carbs, then other 220 carbs.... it doesn't make any sense and hate that I pay for a premium subscription. I've given the update 2 months and it is still awful. I want my money back.

Used to be a decent free app to use, but it’s time has passed. This happens on the daily: starting body weight reverts to 10 years ago weight, CALORIE GOAL RESETS to a random number, specified macro percentages reset. (Always get tipped off when I get a 🎉celebration🎉 for reaching my protein goal after I’ve had a breakfast + 1 chicken breast… sure Jan.) It’s BEYOND frustrating. This has been happening to me for weeks, I see today that there was an app update 2 days ago. Guess what? They didn’t fix this know bug. To top it off I’m concerned about privacy and how they use my personal data so I’m done.
I haven’t used it in a long time and just signed back in. It has no real features, and premium version is overpriced. WOW! Deleted account right away.

This app has not kept up with technology. I was excited to get back on my fitness journey after 10 years. I used this app before and loved it, but its exactly the same as it used to be, but more expensive. Still tons of barcodes that don't work (why do I have to hand-enter them when we have AI?), trying to import recipes is an absolute joke. I've basically paid to hand-enter every single meal even though I use HelloFresh, the most common meal prep. don't even try to take a photo and log it.

Been using this app for years prior to the addition of "premium" & "premium plus" The constant ads & prompts to pay is annoying. The price too high. Was aggravating when I opened the app to find out I was no longer able to do certain things I was able to do prior when the "premium" addition was added. Doesn't allow me to even search for anything. This app had become nothing but a trash money grab. The greed is real

No fees. No constant hassle. EXACTLY what I needed. This is a well thought out APP with tons of options and customizability. I've tested at least 10. This app is superior. Love that it includes exercise of all types, water, you name it. If the price was say...$4/month or $35 annually I'd subscribe to Premium. They've got to lower the price. I'd even recommend it on social media.

glitches sometimes and has to be Uninstalled and redownloaded. does the job. there are better options now but I've used this one for so long that it is just easier to stick with. some of the paid features are free on other apps. mainly the scanning option but it doesn't take long to type in what you are looking for. I've lost weight using this twice, once before pregnancy and once after in my early 40's. tracking macros works, no matter how you choose to do it

Paid for Membership. Dsappointed to not easily tweak saved recipes & adjust portion sizes of meals. Obviously not going to have the exact same amount of ingredients every time I make it. The recipe's the same but ingredient portions might change & there needs to be a setting for it. Also why can't I favorite meals I have regularly instead of searching for it? I have a coffee & greens drink daily, but have to spend 5 mins daily to add it? Barcode scanner barely works. Pls fix it.
I don’t know why apps always need to be updated to be so fancy and modern sometimes simple is best. We’re already so overstimulated the older version was nice and simple
Easy to use and has a good selection of food items what is missing is the possibility of writing down our recipe including nutritional value macronutrient and calorie

I've used this app for years and used to love it, but over the past couple of years it has become frustrating to use. Features that I used to rely for quick and easy logging, like remembering recent exercises and foods, no longer works. Additionally the app will randomly log me out while I'm in the middle of trying to log something. MyFitnessPal used to be the perfect easy to use app, but has been updated into being a buggy and unintuitive mess.

This app is great when it works. The new feature to copy a meal from one day to the next is fantastic. However, it just doesn't work half the time I want to use it. I can't even tell you all the problems I have getting into the app and logging food because the character limit here prevents me. I truly want to love this app and recommend it fully, but I just can't. It's so buggy and frustrating. Not to mention features that were free several years ago cost money (booo!).

awful- the entry system is inconsistent and seems to rely on other people previous in puts. example- you add carrots. but instead of saying- "how carrots and letting you choose the measurement, no! it's a list of everything people have ever added with the word "carrot" in it. could be in cups could be a brand of carrots could be an arbitrary measurement. how long is a large carrot anyway? never been turned off an app this fast in my life!

was a good app. latest update on the free version is not good. took away useful dashboard view, changed buttons so it is too easy to fat-finger the wrong options, harder to see an overview of the foods for a whole day. adds are now intrusive. more clicks to do less. it briefly went back to old version, and i thought they realized how bad the update was. no, appears they think this is better. I keep trying, but its now just too hard to use. not worth it. will be changing to a different app.

I found a lot of value in this app prior to the most recent update, but the app is much less intuitive/user friendly than it used to be. Features meant to be helpful are frustrating, and I waste time correcting and deleting mistakes, which was never an issue before. Will be looking for an alternative Update: changing from two stars to one because no matter what food I search it says the food doesn't exist and I can only create my own foods lol, this is a new issue I haven't had before
Seriously I don’t know what your developers were thinking. I will actively be seeking out alternatives since you guys have done absolutely nothing since the April refresh do fix this.

Used to love this app. I stopped using it. Decided to start using it again, however, you have to be willing to share all your sensitive information in order to download it again. Absolutely ashamed of how you’ve changed things!
Used this app since 2018 - the new update has me cancelling my premium version and looking elsewhere. I just can’t get behind this despite using it and still trying to get used to it.

Rubbish if you use Garmin in track exercise. It used to work absolutely fine but since the change of layout it just doesn't want to connect to Garmin Connect for steps or exercise so i'm now having to use Garmin Connect to track everything. So frustrating. Building receipes is also really glitchy now. It can take ages to save and then the receipes disappear. Some times they are there using the search but other times they need re-inputting. when my subscription ends i wont be renewing.

The app used to work perfectly fine until the latest UI overhaul. Super laggy, extra clicks to get where you want, you add a food entry and it's gone when you go back to check it, it doesn't put the items in the order you entered them in, so it's harder to keep track of what you've entered. They're just lucky it's the one app that works with my insurance to save money, otherwise I'd be gone after the latest UI update. Had to write this after the app pooped the bed adding a couple food entries.

What could the dev team possibly have been thinking? Absolutely atrocious adjustment to the apps design and function. You are a calorie tracking app - it doesn’t need to be remodelled and redesigned. Whoever made this new layout should be removed - yes it’s that bad. Give us an option to go back to the previous layout. Until then I’ll switch apps. This may seem like an overreaction but having used the app for some time and it having been perfect for my needs, this unnecessary change has actively driven me away.

Free version of the app works well enough for tracking macros, plenty of logged foods to select from, and it's easy enough to add your own foods and recipes. There's an occasional glitch where it will log my breakfast twice, so I have to check at the end of the day or next day to make sure everything is correct and delete duplicate entries as needed.

You've made updates to the UI which weren't really needed. You should, instead, focus on the search functionality. Improvements in substring searches would be great. Please add a session timeout check to it too, because when your session dies, the search just stops functioning and the app doesn't kick you back to login. Speaking of login, biometrics would be a nice add. Also, there are a while lot of "verified" foods which are simply incorrect. Please clean up your database.

It is an okay app. The problem I have with it is that free users have to search for every food that they had. And when you do look it up they have a bunch of different options of the same food but different calories. super confusing. Not only that but the scanning feature and the barcode feature are all locked behind a paywall. witch is $20 A MONTH which is crazy. And the app is also super buggy.

The new UI makes everything harder to see quickly and more steps to do. I can no longer easily see my entire day's food diary because I have to click on each meal individually to see what is in it. There is too much crammed together on the page and every field has too much padding, so you always have to scroll to get down to your diary. It worked well before and was compact. I have been using this app for 14 years and now looking for an alternative.

This app has slowly chipped away at all of the features that made it good and and put them behind a paywall. I rated it 5 stars in 2013. I am happy after switching to Samsung Health, which never disconnects from my watch, tries to sell me anything extra, and doesn't even force ads on me. They're already using my data for who knows what, might as well let me use the data that users like me helped to build. The only reason I'm giving it 2 stars instead of 1 is because the calorie database is huge.
i'm sure this used to be great and is probably fine for premium users but the ads are NEVERENDING and most of the features are paid. i kept it less than five minutes. :( super disappointing.

I've been using mfp for years. while I like the UI and the big database, I miss scan the barcode function that used to be in the free ver. + would've been nice to be able to add photos of your meals. I did like the recent feature of weekly average kcals. but today, it randomly messed up my previously logged days by adding calories on its own, duplicating meals and ruining the stats, for MONTHS into the past. can only fix it manually, I don't have the patience for that. hence the rating.
The new update has ruined fitness pal, and I am actively seeking alternatives. why did they ruin this??

reviews.t: Myfitnesspal is the greatest calorie tracking app
reviews.x: Don’t fall for any of the AI tracking BS. Myfitnesspal offers a super easy to understand, interactive UI, and genuinely has helped me get to having abs for the first time in my life. 5/5 I dedicate a lot of my fitness progress to this app.

I highly value MyFitnessPal. However, I am unable to endorse the current version due to the exclusion of the barcode scanning feature from the standard offering. It is my understanding that this functionality is now exclusively available as part of the premium subscription, which I find to be an unreasonable change. It might be time for a free alternative.
Ugggh, unhappy with the update. Please get rid of those celebration banner popups and allow us to set our own week start date again!

I haven't yet found a better app... but I've down graded from 5 stars to 3. Two reasons... the new UI is horrible in my opinion. little things like swiping left and right for days have gone. It's harder to see what you've added when you're adding multiple ingredients... it's just... meh. Secondly and more importantly the foods need a really good clean up. There's so much 'noise' with user added values it's really difficult to actually find the food with the right nutritional value now. Shame.

This app used to be a great, free way of logging your food without any nonsense, now its an absolute mess with this new format & horrible to use! I updated & went to log my food & now can't find anything. The daily journal page with the days at the top & huge banners are off putting, the right swipe to move back to yesterday is gone now you have to click the date at the top & then remember to go back into today otherwise it'll stay on the other date. 10yrs of simple, no BS food tracking gone.

The company is so obsessed with charging more for subscriptions that they keep releasing half baked or generally terrible features and introducing new more expensive subscription tiers. The intermittent fasting features for example aren’t even as good as the worst free apps on the App Store but it’s behind a paywall for MyFitnessPal. The meal planning thing they’re pushing now for more money beyond premium is t with a penny. They’re charging $10 a month for an app that should be free.

I want to love this app, but when you’re diet tracking you just want to do it quickly and get it over with. If you miss a day, the “streak” starts all over again and you get an annoying congratulatory pop-up every time you go to log your first meal of the day. It’s enraging and there is no way to turn it off. And recently, they updated the app so in the recent foods list, when you select an item it scrolls you all the way back to the top. Usually, recent foods that you typically use together are all listed together, which made it easy to add them. But now that it fires you back to the top, you have to keep scrolling down to find additional ingredients. SO IRRITATING. Wish I hadn’t paid for a whole year.

Awesome app, good for tracking all your macros in one place (with premium of course). What I'd love, is folders within the "My Recipes" section so I can create breakfasts, lunches, grilled, fried, chicken, beef, soup etc so it tidies up the list. Would make it a bit nicer! Edit: I'd also love to be able to set my calorie target by week, so if I go over on a Monday it adjusts the rest of the week accordingly - would also be useful for calorie banking if I was planning a big weekend.

Charging for barcode scanning after it was free for years is unacceptable not to mention the huge increase in the price of premium. Nothing but greed and taking advantage of people trying to better themselves

reviews.t: Forces you to agree to share your data in order to use the app.
reviews.x: I used MFP a long time ago and decided to use it again. Years ago, they had a data breach and my information was sold. That was a huge breach of my trust in this company. Now I have to let them share my data? No thanks.

Good but.... there's a major bug with syncing. I connected Health Connect so MFP will automatically sync my workouts from other apps, and it works great, but... the issue is that EVERY. SINGLE. TIME. it syncs it DUPLICATES THE WORKOUTS FROM THE OTHER APP???? So when it says like "Walking, 20 minutes at 01:00 PM" it'll duplicate that entry upwards of 5 times every time you open MFP causing it to sync. And I keep having to delete the duplicates or I have "5000 calories left for the day". Annoying.

The update is horrible. Bad changes: - weeks start on Sunday and you can’t edit. - Hard to view weeks in review as M-S. last 7 days isn’t helpful. - can’t delete full meals. Need to delete item by item. Still not fixed: - can’t carry a full meal across multiple days at one time. Need to copy forward one meal at a time. Been using this app since 2012. Never been so dissatisfied. If I started using it today I would stop.

I have been using this app for over a decade, it was good while you could use it to track your meals. The new update is horrible and forces you to click through several options just to log your meal. Really messed up a functional app!
It was a beautiful, extremely helpful app back in 2014. But with every recent update it keeps getting worse. Unintuitive, limited functionality, uninformative. Please bring back the original design.
I don’t know how you did it but somehow you guys have broken this app. It just doesn’t work anymore.

6/8/26: I previously rated the app 5 stars. It worked pretty well and was easy to use. The latest update changed the interface, making it hard to use and hard to find the features you're looking for. When viewing the weekly average of Progress, the week dates seem to be hard set and doesn't allow you to change the dates. If I could, I'd roll back to the previous version.

I did rate this 5 stars in 2017 and have been using it since before then. But ever since their update in 2026, which has made it less user-friendly, more clicks to get to things, hiding information and many other downgrades, I am actually uninstalling. I didn't think I would see the day. But when the app becomes a barrier between me getting to eat my meal because Im spending more time logging my food, its a no from me. There are other alternatives to use now on the play store.

Who is making the decisions for this app? Everything yall do screws things up more and more. Go look at some of the original versions. That is what made yall popular.. from being able to save recipes, to changing calories for the day and it updating correctly to being able to see all of your meals. Also, to find a day I did a certain activity, i have to click a day and scroll all the way down. At least put the Exercise up top with the Calories eaten etc like it use to be.

I've been using this app for many years. With the last UI update, there are far more steps than needed to get to a point, my foods have been disappearing, and you can no longer delete multiple things at a time as before. One thing at a time is problematic especially when a reason I now have to do this is its far too easy to pick to use the previous day's meal. It seems apps change things to freshen up but end up ruining the basics and what has worked well. I'd rather have old and functioning.

Going the wrong direction. New UI is terrible. Go back to how it was! We want to see all foods for each meal without more nested menus and selecting. Perfect for me would be the old format with an option to add a checkbox next to food. I log one day ahead of time and the next day I just eat based on what is logged. would be nice to be able to check off what food has been eaten so far and what hasn't. If the old layout doesn't come back I won't be renewing the premium and I'll be changing apps

the app itself is great, really helps track your meal logging well, probably the best I've used. since some recent update however, the notifications are horrendous. things like ' The truest horror story - you not logging your meal' or 'Not logging your meal? you'll make us sad'. paraphrasing, but theyre SO try hard, it makes me think about wanting to uninstall. it doesn't have to be quirky, just a generic meal logging reminder is enoough
The app is so buggy. Logging weight takes forever because the button doesn’t show up

very happy with the app for recording calories, but be aware that when using the free version that some of the ads are from known scam/data collecting companies. Not purely illegal, but certainly something users need to be aware of. Be wary of the ads. Would love to have the scan barcode available again in the free version too.

Oh my gosh - the new path forward is horrible. If you need all your macros on a per meal basis? next to impossible. the "old" platform kept things visible and usable, now everything is layered, clunky, and takes so much more time. Who has time for an app that's so expensive, supposed to make things easier and is now more time consuming?! simple things like negative calories for a "meal" (i.e. pregnancy) no longer exist.
It is easy and simple to follow. Just I wish that the meal plan was free and I wouldn’t have to pay for it.

Have used for over 10 years, helping me to lose over 150 lbs - no drugs or surgery. However, the program just gets worse and worse with each update, sometimes fixing one problem but causing 10 other new ones! I'm searching for something else, but so far, nothing I've tried is any better, tho, for me, it's different issues than with MFP. Hanging on here for the time being, but I'm thoroughly exasperated.

I accidently updated this app today and its new look is as bad as everyone complains on the forums, my husband stopped using it and I now need to find a new app, new update is not intuitive or logical, can’t easily find information and can’t reverse update , if I could give this a negative 5 stars I would, logging food should be easy not a major headache, person who designed update should be fired, don’t fix what was not broken, and learn about the KISS Principle for life in general, no one needs this stress when trying to get healthy
It s frustrating that I upgrade my phone and now I can no longer scan items to log food under the free version.
Cool I have a log streak, I don’t need a pop up about it everyday, that I can’t even turn off

I've been using this app for almost 2 years. It is extremely laggy, it has also logged me out countless times while I'm tracking my food, and it will add a food to my meal multiple times instead of the one time I clicked on it. It's a very difficult app to use at times, and the recent update made it much more confusing to navigate.
Lost my original profile had to create a new one! I used to be able To scan barcodes now it wants me to pay for it

Uninstalled. Not sure why, but today the layout changed and it's terrible. I didn't update the app, nor do I have it set to download automatically. Before, I could view every item in breakfast, lunch and dinner on one page. Now, multiple items are grouped together and I have to do an extra step to go into each section to view all the items, including water/exercise. It's discombobluated. Can we PLEASE have the option to change it back? What was the point of messing with a perfectly good thing?
Amazing app when you know how to use it, and super helpful coming from someone who can’t afford apps this is perfection!!

reviews.t: The new update has ruined it
reviews.x: I was subscribed to this app for many years. The new update has ruined the interface. Now I can’t see the list of the food items in my meals, I’m not gonna renew my membership anymore.

I've had this app for about 5 years. It's easy to use, has plenty of functions and that's not even having the premium package. it's great to track daily eating habits as well as keeping you (and only you) accountable to reach your goals whatever they are. The notifications are great for times when you forget to track. Easy setup with phones/watches so logs your workouts, walks, hikes, bikes whatever and adds to your daily calories/daily expenditure. awesome for beginners all the way to advanced

Terrible experience. The app got an update recently and it’s now soooo slow to use. It is unusable. I’ve now switched to MyNetDiary and it’s much better. Truly horrific update. I’ve lost trust in MyFitnessPal. Classic move when a private equity firm acquires a good app and then ruins it by prioritizing monetization of the user base instead of engineering quality.

I'm not sure why an app that worked fine for so long has decided to redesign everything, but this change is a huge downgrade. Why doesn't the week start on Monday? Why is it more clicks to add multiple items to a meal? Why is it so easy to accidentally repeat a meal? Why is it harder to differentiate base calories and additional calories? I'm not sure I can find one thing that feels like an upgrade. After many years I am going to test alternative apps. This one is no longer good enough.
I do not like the new app at all. The old version was MUCH BETTER. Aughhhhh

New app UI is unusable. Layout makes no sense. Quick add calories really hard to find. First touch button for diary is to copy yesterday's meal. Diary, which is the whole point of the app, no longer has its own page. It's a mess. Every year this app gets worse but this is the final straw for me and I'm moving to another calorie counter.

this is not a bad app...but it doesn't do a good job with integration from other apps. for example, I use a Garmin to track my sleep and that doesn't get uploaded no matter how many times I've "reconnected/resynched" the apps . I'm looking for a one-stop shop (nutrition , exercise, sleep) and this doesn't offer it. for a calorie counter/tracking though...its great;

so until this month, the MFP layout hadn't really changed much in the eight years I've used it. and apparently the app designers had to justify their presence in the office. I'm not one to complain about every little change, but now it takes more clicks to add my weight, more clicks to track my meals, more clicks to delete things, and it's way easier to add repeat meals on accident. all that and it looks worse somehow. what were y'all even going for? literally fire whoever pitched this
The newest update has completely destroyed the functionality of this app. Why can I no longer put custom things on the homepage. I won’t be paying going forward.

Was a happy paying customer until the horrible new user interface came about a month ago. I can't track my nutrients as easily anymore without having to click 3 buttons deep. Also, have to manually delete 1 food item at a time instead of being able to mass delete like before. Go back to the old user interface. Will unsubscribe soon if this keeps up.
The food logging doesn’t work for me anymore. I have a brand new iPhone too

reviews.t: You can manage what you don’t monitor
reviews.x: The path to positive change is understanding the direction that needs to be altered and the path that need to be followed. MyFitnessPal is the perfect compass.

Just deleted this app after years of having it because I’m tired of the toxic notifications. Yes I can turn them off and you can too, but I refuse to support an app that sends notifications like “don’t make us remind you again” WHAT
Bring back the old simple design
I’ve been using this for 13+ years, and has always been amazing, the newest upgrade made it not so much :(

reviews.t: The voice log feature is trash
reviews.x: Sucks at recognizing what you’ve said and so often come up with the wrong match. So many other apps have gone AI let’s enter 2026 mfp

This is still probably the best app for tracking because they have such a large amount of entries to choose from and it's free. However, I really used to like the way this app worked and looked, but now the user interface is so much worse. Harder to navigate and find where things are. Additionally, the default when you look at your nutrition breakdown is set to weekly and there's no way to permanently make it default to daily like it used to be. That's not a big deal but it is annoying.

Last update sucked. The new format makes everything more confusing. It's gotten harder to go back and log things you've forgotten without getting the days mixed up. It's too easy to inadvertently log yesterday's meals on today's log. The counter for your calorie allotment was much easier to read at a glance. Seems like a huge format change that improved nothing.
This is the worst app update in human history.
I love this app, wish it was totally free though.

This new app update is AWFUL. It’s honestly disgusting too use, They went too “modern” looking for other apps because i can’t stand it. the look is gross. i want the old version back. i’ve been using this app for YEARS but unless they change back i’ll find something better.

Known bugs of custom meal duplicating still exist after years (and no way to delete it). Feature parity againts iOS version (missing upload to scan feature which is a dealbreaker for me as I cannot log airplane meals where there is no internet connection). Data syncing issue with health connect (steps are not getting synced, activities are duplicated). Otherwise pretty hefty database for foods (when it comes to macros, but micro-nutrients are usually ignored even for some with barcode foods).

This app has helped me easily keep track of my calorie carb intake. it's helpful to keep track 👣 of everything I'm eating along with a log of my daily exercises. helepd me lose 30 lbs 3 times in a decade. My problem is getting off track. gaining lots of weight then working hard to lose it again. that is all within my fault. the losing weight can definitely be credited to this app through the years. easy to use. tried and true.

App is harder to navigate now. More confusing, diary tab is gone, things moved around for no good reason. It takes longer to do anything and is not user friendly, especially for people who have been using this app for years and years and were familiar with the old layout. I really dislike that meals appear as “ingredient and 3 more” instead of actually listing everything unless you click through. I used to use drag and sort a lot, and now I can’t use that. It’s a lot harder to sort or scroll through things in general. I’ve had this app for nearly a decade, but this update has me looking elsewhere.

this latest update has ruined this app. there are more glitches and issues now than before. If I try and go back to see what my macros are it gives me some random set of numbers. I have to close out the app and reopen every single time. not to mention that toggling back and forth between the screens is super annoying. I'll start typing in a food and the cursor jumps back to the first letter. When pressing the add button it takes 10-15 seconds to update. that's just what I can remember at the mom

The recent interface update pushed me over the edge to cancel. Been using this for easily a decade or two? It was the gold standard and I referred friends and family to it. Seems they got rid of the UX team or something because the new UI is bulky, too many clicks to get things done that were easy to see and do before. I can no longer see everything eaten in a day, have to click in meal by meal. Date and logging info are unclear. The only redeeming benefit is the large database. Not worth it.

The new interface is horrible! Why why why did you make such a drastic change? I can no longer see important stats such as fiber, sodium, etc. Instead they switched to be like every other app on the market and only focus on macros. Forget being able to see what your daily calories are, what has been eaten and what was added in from exercise. If you want that information you have to pull out a calculator. Will be canceling my membership.

After 7+ years, I've finally had the last straw and need to move to a different app. I wanted to give a detailed laundry list to maybe help with constructive feedback, but I was limited by characters, so basically, it was making it difficult to get to the section that was actually useful, intrusive ads, more intrusive ads, an misguided update, but the final straw was having several months of data erased out of nowhere. So goodbye, and hopefully a new paradigm will get me on track.
The new update is absolutely terrible. The interface is awful, its harder to use

The user interface is counterintuitive, it takes multiple clicks/taps to get to essential information - namely, calories and macros for each meal and day. I don’t want a snapshot and then tap to see more. I just want the food diary. No social network. No nutrition plan I have to subscribe to. I absolutely hate the new MFP, especially the pricing. You have made a functional app complete garbage. I will be cancelling my subscription after being a loyal user for over 10 years. If anyone has an app recommendation similar to the old MFP let me know! I am switching as soon as possible.

TERRIBLE DESIGN!!! It's even more difficult to log food and to see what you've logged. The app used to be user friendly. but the last two so-called "upgrades" are just getting worse and worse. What good is it to me to see a meal as "Chicken + 2 more"? It's more useful to be able to see all meals, with complete entries for each day. This is the WORST yet. If I could give it ZERO stars I would. I guess it's time to start shopping for a different calorie app.

I used this years ago before getting a fitbit & switching to their app. I loved it back then. Just re-downloaded due to Google rolling out their half finished Health app to replace fitbit. After seeing that the barcode scanner is no longer available in the free version, I have deleted this without logging a thing. It is all but useless without being able to scan. Both of these apps I used to use and love have eliminated so many features I might as well long with pen and paper.
I cant see everything on one screen like before, its just a bs summary of each meal and I have to click around like a crazy person to see and log. TRASHHH
Much less user friendly. Less information, not as easy to navigate. Preferred the older version.

Have to agree to all their data sharing to even use the app. And now even barcode logging is hidden behind the paywall. Premium price is insanely expensive and does not provide that much value. Used to be a good app when I used it years ago, but now is useless.

Ça fait déjà plusieurs années que je l’utilise et pour ceux qui sont hautement soucieux de leur apport nutritionnel, MyFitnessPal est un outil redoutable pour la saine gestion de votre alimentation, vos dépenses et bien plus encore!
The app is soooooo much easier to use now. I LOVE the new changes. Wondeful!

I’ve had this app for years and it used to be super helpful. Ever since the update, it takes at least twice as long to do things. I can no longer easily swipe between the days. You can’t easily see all your logs for the day. It just says “lunch was xyz plus 2 more” so if I want to see what it was I have to click on the meals and scroll rather than it just being visible in the first place. It’s hard to tell which day I’m on because if I tap the black checkmarks to change days they are so small and all look the same so I have to pay very close attention to what day I’m clicking on. Plus, the feature where it shows what you ate vs burned off is a weird design and confuses me. Rather than just simply adjusting the original calorie target, it adjusts the entire number of what your target started with. Features are difficult to find and the data is structured weird so it’s hard to interpret. If the only version doesn’t come back soon I’m going to probably find a different app. Not sure why they would do this when the old version worked better and everyone hates the new update

reviews.t: Shame on you My Fitness Pal
reviews.x: I also agree with not wanting to share my data when they don’t tell you who they are sharing the data with! Bad form!
I’ve used this app for over 10 years. Raved to many including doctors about how great it is. No more

This app really helps log your food and exercise. Totally recommended! Update 5.22.26 This app isn't as good as it used to be. Even with the premium version, the barcode never worked and they changed the style completely. The worst part was when I used to be able to copy a meal, but now I have to insert it individually. It's kind of frustrating. I can't even find the recipes I logged when I first started. Also, it doesn't connect with my Google Pixel watch.

Multi-year Premium subscription: I find this app much clunkier and user-unfriendly than it was previously. Even simple things like logging food are less visible, and making changes is harder. To add a food, there is a choice of private, friends only or public. It seems impossible to change this after setting it up. I chose private, as I wanted to test it out, but then I couldn't add in a recipe or meal... Nor could I change it to public. Definitely feel I am getting less for my money.

Please revert back I’ve been using this app for four years and now I feel like I’ve lost all my progress. The new update is horrible the UI requires too many extra clicking. No more easy swiping and easy visuals. Please. Revert. Back!!

*addition to the earlier review below: a month later on the new platform - no improvements, still inefficient, more steps to accomplish entries. And again have to reiterate - the font is SO small & SO faint. You really need to improve it. It’s like a 7pt font! The new interface is really bad. SO hard to read, fonts too small & too faint, idiotic & inefficient how they’ve broken up everything. I now have to click through multiple step to enter one item that I used to be able to do in one step. Overheats phone. The old Dashboard menu was perfect at-a-glance. Now gone. Been using this app for 10+ years, & honestly this is the worst. It was a simple, efficient, clean interface before. Ruined it.
The update is not great. I miss the old layout that allows you to flip your phone to see macros per meals. Plz bring it back

I loved this app, and the extreme redesign is not user friendly. I can’t easily see my calories per meal or the clear deduction of my exercise. The previous dashboard was so clear and easy to navigate. I just keep picturing the meetings that led to this redesign and how many people had to agree that the changes were beneficial. I cannot wrap my head around it. They took something great and just kept adding more useless features while removing the ease and clarity of the old design. I’m all for change, but in terms of improvement. I’m starting to search for another app.

I have been a dedicated user of the premium version for 8 years. While I wanted to love the recent updates to the interface because it looks fresh - the functionality has suffered. It's difficult/impossible to see an entire day at a glance. Copying meals from day to day isn't seamless and I always end up with things entered on, or copied to, the wrong day. The app feels cumbersome with extra steps needed to log food and meals.

As of the most recent update at the beginning of May, the app no longer tracks my steps through any of the options I have available (Google Fit, Samsung Health, or Android Health Connect). I've tried disconnecting and reconnecting them all, separately, multiple times. Including clearing the caches. This is incredibly frustrating as now MFP doesn't allow me to properly track my calories, and does not allow any manual input of step counts. Please fix this, or allow us to input steps manually.

Not loving the new update. Its not convenient to have to go to the top to change days and then have to open each meal separately and repeat. I plan multiple days ahead and need to be able to quickly and easily see my foods. I wish they would add the swipping feature back to see the different days, and not have only 1 food per meal show on the main page.

Have used this app since 2015 and it helped me lose weight (and keep it off) but the new update is horrible. I have to click twice as many times to get to the same screens as I did before the update. The "home" page does not show details of my diary at a glance like the old version did. My exercise from MapMyWalk does not transfer over like it used to and like it should. Please go back to the old version!

For a long time, the app worked well. I enjoyed logging my meals and trying to keep them under the calorie counts. then recently the app stopped working. Every time I open it, the app brings me to a loading screen that for a split second looks like it's letting me in and then back to the loading screen. can somebody help? Regarding your response, I can't open the app so I won't be able to contact you through it. thank you.

New diary user interface makes it difficult to use. Problems including accidentally logging previous days items. I can no longer see everything I've logged from the day on one screen, I have to click on each meal and view them all separately. It is difficult to go through history of past weeks now. It used to be obvious how many calories I had left with dashboard, now it is this tiny little number. I've used this app for years, I was always afraid an update like this would happen.

I'm compare it to lose it. way better app. main issue is the search tool and even after you add and used an entry if it passes 2 weeks I think it won't remember it. you have to search for it again and often can't find it. also can't make corrections. It happens often for me that it show the European nutrition and serving size and now I have to do weird fractions to figure out correct calories, but macros are wrong. Even though I'm paying for the service I have limited reports I can run

reviews.t: Good to use while eating mindfully
reviews.x: Only issue you could have is struggling to find something that matches what your eating like if you make your own protein muffin

Excellent for those of us who are serious about losing weight, or just generally improving health (as of 02/16/2017). However, of late, I have noticed a significant issue with this app. It used to auto-sync my workout logs from MapMyWalk and MapMyFitness (including importing my step count from my walk logs); but no longer does so. Correct this immediately, please.

Haven't used it in a while and don't even recognize it now. It was so SIMPLE for the things I needed to do. Now it's visually VERY cluttered and the greed is on full display: a lot that was free is now "premium," and the upsell is more aggressive than a used car dealer! What used to feel like it supported MY goals is much, MUCH more about supporting theirs. PRIVATE EQUITY RUINS EVERYTHING, and what a great and thorough example MyFitnessPal has become. Don't like it, wouldn't recommend it.

Previously a premium user, but only when on offer because at full price, its far too expensive. Recent updates have now made this awful to use so now looking for other alternatives. Lack of barcode scanning means that searching through the millions of entries for food is exhausting and nearly impossible to get right. UX is clunky and all exercises from samsung watch is duplicated. Calories left in allowance also changes randomly, which could lead to overeating against calorie goals.

Loving the improvements I've seen over the years returning to this app. Now it's a daily habit. It's great for motivation. *UPDATE- 5 down to 3 stars. No longer as great. paywall and ads. Also used it for 10+ yrs and one thing that's always bothered me is that the weight progess graph isn't more user friendly. gimme a slider! *2ND UPDATE- 3 down to 2 stars. kept logging me out every 2 weeks, even when I would use it every three days or less.

I do NOT like the update. Would give zero if I could. I am a paid subscriber. I don't like the new layout. Don't like that I can't see the projected weight more than once after I click finish diary for the day. I don't like that when I go to see Protein, Carbs, Fat it defaults to weekly #s instead of that day. It's terrible. Put it back the way it was.
The app takes a good 2-3 minutes to open on the newest iPhone.

I originally lost and maintened a loss of 50+ lbs with MFP. Now that I've gone through pregnancy, I need to do the same thing again, but this app feels completely unusable. I can't easily set my calorie goal. I get no say in how much I want to restrict myself. Everything is about the paid subscription. I'm choosing something else, and will be recommending against this app.

(1) Meal Scanning Let me scan the Nutrition Facts food label and add the calories, fat, protein, carbs, fibre, sugar, etc. It’s all right there on the label. Even the serving size is on there too. Everything is there. No guessing required! Why won’t you let me just scan the food label with the nutrition already on it?? (2) Data sharing consent. Not happy with this. Especially for paying users. Need transparency with data & privacy usage. And the ability to opt out of non-essential purposes for paying users. (3) Bottom tab bar. Let me customize it for the features I use and want. So I can have quick access to what I need without tapping into multiple menus and navigating different screens. Fix these 3 things, and I’ll gladly change this to a five star review!
Even with a paid subscription the app refuses to open when you have an add blocker on your phone. Cancelling subscription.

This app used to be quite useful to track caloric intake, exercise, weight, etc. now it doesn't load beyond the startup splash screen unless I clear the app's storage, and even then I'm unable to add food to the dairy. this issue has been ongoing for a while now, and attempts to get help from support have been useless.

I've been using MyFitnessPal since 2020, and although the app did have some flaws, the new update makes it impossible to use. I keep accidentally adding meals I had previously into a the new logs, you can no longer move meals in between meal times, and the meal search button is way hidden. When I want to look at a meal I had last week, then move the bar back to this week, it immediately sets it at the day you were looking at last week. How annoying! I accidentally put all my meals on May 23rd.

The new interface is terrible, as it’s now much more of a pain to see what you’ve input already for each meal. The app now requires you to carry out even more steps just to locate where to input data for each meal. It’s also so incredibly unattractive to look at. I don’t even want to open this piece of trash, and am considering abandoning it after several years of consistently using it.

I love this app. if you are dedicated and willing to put in the work, this app will help you keep track of your calories. I like it. The only complaint that I have is if you add something to the food menu and you make a mistake, there's no way to correct that, at least no way that I've seen. For instance I added a meal to the menu and I forgot to put the calories in but had all the other information correct, however I didn't know how to go back and either delete that entry or correct it.
I don’t like it. Dry confusing!

I've been using your app for years and today May 16, 2026 I took the latest update ...big mistake. Why have you changed the way the diary displays? It was absolutely perfect the way it was and now you've made it more difficult to see all the foods that you've logged. I don't know what the reason would be? Maybe you're trying to make it more difficult so people will upgrade to premium? I can tell you, as one of those people, if a person wants premium, they'll upgrade. Nothing you do to wreck the free part of the app will make a person take premium, they'll just quit the app and go somewhere else. Insert disgusted head shaking here.

The newest update is absolute trash. While I’ve been using this app for coming on 5 years, this is the catalyst to make me look for another app. There’s no visualization of stats, just weird headings that don’t connect to anything & now all your important info isnt easy to see, plus it’s not all visible on one screen. I highly urge you to rethink this update

The newest update in 2026 is clunky and difficult to use. I’ve been using this app for years and always found it very user-friendly but now things are hard to find. I can’t see what I’m looking for. I just do not like this. Please change it back.

NOBODY WANTS THIS. Absolutely awful UI update. Previously the app was streamlined, data readily visible, fast and efficient. Ridiculous that now that basic functions seemed locked behind additionalsteps. Example 1: I can no longer swipe left and right to go back and forth through days. I have to repeatedly use the picker at the top. PAINFUL. Example 2: Previously I can see everything I logged for every meal, all from the main screen. Now I see "Basmati rice and 4 more". THAT'S NO USE TO ANYONE.
The steps are always inaccurate and my phone always has way more than the app

reviews.t: Horrible new UI update do NOT update your app
reviews.x: New ui update is clunky and difficult to use (even after giving it a genuine attempt to learn it), the previous UI was much cleaner and simpler. I’ve been using MFP since 2018 but this is what finally got me to swap to LoseIt (even though LoseIt’s UI is far worse than the *old* MFP UI, the new MFP UI is so awful that it’s worth moving everything to LoseIt & putting up with their UI). Not sponsored by loseit it anything lol just want a decent simple consistent calorie tracking app that isn’t a nightmare to use.

In order to delete your account you have to consent your data and allow them access to your personal information. I received a warning that my data tied to this account has been sold. DO NOT USE THIS SERVICE THEY WILL SELL YOUR DATA. The app sucks not even worth it.

unfortunately I think this is the best app for meal tracking. one major issue they haven't fixed in 10 years, you can't filter your food results when searching. example I had a Tim Hortons almond milk late. you can't select the restaurant and filter the food. if I want to add a missing item it just goes into their mass random search with all the other junk. they need to have a 3 teir system. approved items, ones added by users, and

Just change for the sake of change, no other reason. This new UI makes everything more inconvenient and more difficult, nobody asked for this at all. Waste of time and money spent making this update. Its bad enough to the point im switching apps. MacrosFirst is the same concept as MFP but much easier to use (since this update) id recommend others switch as well

In my opinion the latest app update on Android has made it worse and less user friendly. I can no longer see the food that I've consumed for a day in one screen. I cannot delete individual meals from a day, I cannot change the order in which the foods list in my meals, it's very irritating. I think that it's still the best free app that I can find but that it's poorer after the update.
