They charged me immediately after I started my free trial. Their scanners also sucks - the only reason I got a trial was to give the scanner a try. Your appologies doesn’t do anything for me. Give me my money back you thieves.

This new update is so clunky and difficult to use. Everything now takes at least 3 or 4 extra clicks, there's no way to see my full food diary in a single view anymore. Lunch is "mayo and 5 others"? How is that helpful? The nutrition summary is misleading since it now defaults to a weekly average. You've made food tracking so frustrating and annoying that it's no longer useful and I'm finally willing to give up my 15+ years of historical data and recipes to switch to a better app.

2025 update: support doesn't respond. App is now deleting logged food at random. it's ridiculous that issues like this exist. Old review: My created meals keep getting deleted randomly. Often during or right after creating them. The whole app itself is full of clutter, i just want to track food. The scanner is pretty good. Edit 2026: deleting whole saved meals now. updating app deletes all logged food.
Latest updates have now removed previously free features and made them exclusive to those with an (expensive!) paid membership. I will be finding a different app to track calories 👎
Butchered it with the new update, added a bunch of menus and now it takes longer to do things that used to take one second

reviews.t: Was good for years not anymore
reviews.x: New interface in 2026 is terrible

I found the new update has taken an app that was easy to use for logging my meals and made it far more difficult. I often wait to log my last meal until the next day and I'm finding it more difficult and confusing to do that now. I understand there is always a learning curve when changes happen but it's been awhile and am still finding myself feeling frustrated after the update. I have to constantly change the data to show "today" when checking my nutrients and macros because it defaults toweek.

I’ve never written an app review but I’m so annoyed at this stupid update I was compelled. I’ve been using this app for many years and will probably switch to something else because of how bad this new interface is. Do any of the developers actually USE the app? Please fix the today tab so my Diary is right there. Why do I have to scroll so far to add things now? Why do my macros take up (waste) the top 2/3 of the screen for no good reason? And why can’t it show all the food added to a category instead of “*item* and 3 more”WITHOUT needing to open up an additional and redundant tab to see all. Dumb af update.

I've been using this app since 2011. I currently have a 2,327 day streak. I can understand making some features paid, like barcode scanning, net carbs and other things. Have to make some money. However, this recent user interface update is awful. Has completely ruined the app imo. You got rid of the diary button, replacing it with what looks to be some Ai slop paid feature. You can no longer edit meals, allowing you to copy to another day, or even save certain things. Just completely awful.

So far so good. It lets you search up food items to varying levels of obscurity and track your calorie intake. There are ads and features behind a paywall, but if you're just looking for a calorie watcher with an extensive database of food items this is a good free app for that. Update: -1 star. App is randomly logging me out now and also the changes to the UI are bad.

Great app, I’ve been using it for years, but since the last update the interface is just not a good user experience. If it meant to be minimalistic - it is not and the calorie tracking is now terrible set up.

Been using this app for almost a decade, and the new interface is simply awful. Why such an extreme step backwards in usability? It’s not even the same app anymore. All the easy listings and features are gone. It baffles the mind as to why they would do this, and now it’s forcing all of us to look for a different app. I went on the forums, and hundreds, if not thousands of people have issued the same sentiment. I messaged MyFitnessPal to share this concern. Hopefully they can roll back the changes, but I’ve never seen that happen with an app before. I really don’t want to switch.

It's a good way to track your calories and your exercise. your water intake. It does not talk to Google very well and it's very aggressive if you don't turn off it's notifications. it will harass you all day long until you put something into it. so make sure when you download it you turn off the notifications that way it's on your terms instead of on its terms. edit: 2 out of 5 stars is not a great review. did you even read this? sounds like you have a standard reply for everything.

reviews.t: Issues with slow loading & charts fixed, love this app again!!!
reviews.x: So grateful and happy to have the app working perfectly, best health tracking app ever!! Recent issues with slow loading of charts, new chart formatting and ads covering content are all fixed so quickly and perfectly, thank you

Helps you log calories, constantly bothers you to upgrade if you haven’t. The step tracker will change your info the next day though. Take screenshots or use another tracker for the exercise side as this one tells you one thing & the next day says you were short 600 steps of a goal you thought you’d hit.

reviews.t: Latest UI updates much improve usability
reviews.x: As someone who strictly uses the app to count calorie, the new UI cuts out the clutter of features I don’t need.
The new update is horrible. Everything is much harder to use and just so unnecessary literally hate it and this is gonna stop many people from using.

I’ve used this app for years, mostly successfully. However, in recent months I’ve noticed that many items I add to meals disappear despite getting the “item logged” notification. These are foods that I’ve been logging for years now that no longer work. Not impressed; do better!

I prefer the old UI. I like the copy meal from yesterday and copy to feature, but having to perform multiple taps before getting to see how much calories for each meal is troublesome. I prefer to see all meals for each day like before,in a single pane of glass. Nutrition macros can be hidden until I need to see it, which I don't mind more taps to get to it.

reviews.t: Used to be a great app
reviews.x: The recent redesign for food logging is horrible. Even if you open any meal number it defaults to Meal 1 and you have to change it from a drop down each time. If you open meal 3 you should be logging for meal 3. This app used to be really good. Now it’s just confusing when trying to log and hard to find things.
Although the feel is modern, the display of the calories information and streak is harder to find. Submissions lead to refreshes. Please consider fixing
Please switch layout

The last free version was far more useful, and I averaged 28+ fays login food. It really helped getting a picture of my calories and macros. The UI was a good and made it a tool I relied upon. This newest version is clearly designed to push you to a paid plan; no pie charts for macros at a glance, poor UI, lack of data on a daily basis (how many grams of protein have I had/ need to meet my daily goal?) weekly data is fine but you get there one day at a time.

Who thought making users life more complicated using an app we’ve been using for years ? The layout is extremely difficult for a simple task that before it took seconds. Terrible. DO BETTER. AND CHANGE IT BACK. NO ONE ASKED FOR THIS TRASH UPDATE!!!.

it is an overall alright app but some things need to change. you can't always quick add meals because you don't always know the calories, you would use the scanner for that. I downloaded the app under the impression that I could use the scanner without paying money. I made a salad and went to scan it but it said I needed premium. the only way I could log it was through quick add, which just allows you to add calories, not even fat carbs protein etc. go buy another app, it it probably better.

I have loved and used MyFitnessPal for years and the new UI update is basically app-breaking. Things that were intuitive before are needlessly hidden behind multiple obscure menus, having to swap between multiple screens constantly that you only had to once before, generally confusing and difficult to use. It was fine as it was, and now it’s garbage. Considering changing apps.

reviews.t: Terrible Update and Violates Privacy and you pay them!!!!
reviews.x: Terrible Update on Phone Harder to delete whole meals.

Since the redesigned homepage was released daily tracking is much more frustrating. Total calories are not shown by meal unless you click through two other screens. As you’re logging you can’t see what you’ve already added and to which meal to catch errors. Logging water is less convenient. I will be switching to another app.

I love the macro counting and the amount of food choices and the nutrition but I ABSOLUTELY HATE the new update. It is not easy to toggle back and forth. It is much harder to find and update your food goals. I've been using MFP for many years and this is the first update I have not been happy with. Other than that, they have lots of food items in the database making tracking easy.

Premium subscriber. New version is annoying. Reducing score to 2. Increase size of text for total allowable calories and calories left. Can barely read it. Monday is the first day of the week for loads of people, not Sunday. Need a setting to change it. Why is relogging yesterday's meal so important and easy to accidentally do? Do you have data showing most people eat the same meal every day? I defo don't.

New interface is awfull- can’t see what I want at a glance anymore and instead am stuck with getting unwanted AI “suggestions” and in-your-face reminders of what my weight is. Been a user for 10 years, paid off and on (currently paid). No thanks on this one, won’t be renewing.

I used to love this app,now they have destroyed it. You can no longer look at net calories for the past week as of today's date, which is a critical function for anyone who is tracking calories since overall consistency is the most important thing. You now have to delete items one by one instead of the bulk checkbox way before. You can't properly tell which day you're on. Very disappointing. After 2,273 days streak of using myfitnesspal I will have to move on to a different app! Very sad!

I've used this app off and on for about 15 yrs (maybe a bit more). I have loved it! The new update/format is not easy to use; I know you can get used to new things and find them to be great, but this is not it. The app keeps adding in exercises and giving me more calories per day even though I've deleted the exercise repeatedly and also do not have the setting selected to add more calories to my goal even with exercise. frustrating. Makes tracking more difficult every day.
Having to pay for a barcode scanner is the biggest joke I’ve ever heard of.

I originally gave 5 stars in 2018 but have to drop it to 1 star. This year it stopped syncing to the web so friends couldn't see my diary anymore. Then the new UI came out which made it less user friendly. Then it stopped updating with Garmin. Then recipes stopped saving. Today I noticed entire weeks of my logs from earlier this year have just disappeared. The company has turned a nice product into one that isn't even usable. I recommend looking into the many other options out there.

New interface they've forced onto the user is terrible. It's not intuitive at all and it makes what was once a fairly streamlined logging process a frustratingly tedious slog. I've used MFP for years and it seems to get worse with each major update. If you're at all serious about tracking your food/calories/macros don't waste your time with this app.

reviews.t: Not what it used to be
reviews.x: I used this app several years ago and it worked wonders. Now during menopause I thought I’d like to get back to tracking my nutrition and exercise. The app is no longer user friendly and is only geared towards money grabs. Does anyone one know a user friendly app that helps people track nutrition, exercise, water intake etc?
The new update 👎

I've used this app for years and it has been very helpful in keeping me on track with macros. Recently though I've noticed, when I log my food it does not calculate the macros accurately. Like for example the food I logged added up to 70g in protein but the app told me there was 105g of protein. So I'm sad I haven't been actually meeting my protein goals because the app was telling me I was...if you guys could fix this, I would appreciate it, because I do love this app otherwise!!

OMG, the new update app is so irritating! Changed my raiting because they took away the barcode scan option I've used free for years and added it to the premium pay option. Looks like a greedy move to me. Obviously they weren't getting enough people to purchase the premium option as it was, so they take away what was the most used feature (that was free) and move it to paid only option. Extremely disappointed in My Fitness Pal! I think it might be time to find another food logging app.

Update May 2026: 👎 New forced user experience is lackluster and requires more effort both to log your food and to see what you've logged. Not being able to see the foods in each meal without clicking into each one adds time to a process most people want to streamline as much as possible. Spacing between rows has ballooned. It's too easy to accidentally click the "log previous" button and then have to correct it by deleting the rows of food one by one. I'm now looking for alternative.

reviews.t: Good app but updates WAY too frequently
reviews.x: Great app that lets you track for free but theres an update almost every other day which gets a bit annoying.

I signed up for the free 7-day trial for the premium plan. Even scheduled a text reminder for 6 days later to remind me to access if I liked the features enough to commit or cancel. Well, I was shocked to see next day I had been charged. I submitted request through Play store for a refund and they denied me. I'm going back to using Lose It app and disputing this charge with my bank to get my money back smh. Not a good experience and I don't recommend based off the customer service I received.
Please Allow water tracking on Apple health to sync

I’ve been using MyFitnessPal since 2014. It was great before, but now they ruined it completely with this awful update! The user experience and interface is extremely bad! The weeks start from the last 7 days and not a Monday or Sunday. You have to click in and out to see your daily meals… the list goes on and on… it’s just terrible!!! The genius who signed this off should be fired.

Yeah mirroring what others are saying, the new layout of the app is not good. The fact you can’t just see your calories at a glance on the diary page is diabolical. Having to click on lunch or snacks to view those details is not a good idea. Users want less clicks not more. Level of detail at a glance isn’t there. I would highly consider a revert back to what the app was like before 😅 I find it extremely frustrating to navigate now and can see myself not picking it up again.

They changed the design of the app. Half the good information is no longer shown. You have to click numerous things to see anything and it's just unappealing all around. Also, there was an update and now my app crashes constantly, double and triple logs my food daily. I have to manually go in and delete each of the extra items all the time. It is time consuming and I'm ready to look into a different nutritional tracker app.

The new interface requires so much more work, and multiple taps to view info; gone is the streamlined view and workflow. In addition, my wife and I each have the premium membership, and share recipes and copy meals; now I have to search through settings to get to her profile. So painful. We both renewed for the year about a month ago; but this is not what we paid for. So now we’re stuck with a poor product with no recourse for refund. Please, as so many others have requested, restore the previous interface! Please don’t be obstinate, thinking you know better; we, the customers, are very clearly telling you what we want!

Don't like this new look, everything is more difficult to see & enter with more touches to do it, can't delete an entire meal only one item at a time. The meal calorie numbers are very small & faint on the main screen. Please bring back the diary where you can see your whole day's food on one screen. It might be time to find a new app to use....

Used for years, straight forward to use. Harder to use since update/look. Possibly a way to encourage people to pay for the premium service, & get the most out of it - and that's not a bad thing. Just not a fan of the new updated look, purely personal preference, maybe time will change that.I generally use it when I either have a diet were I need to either ensure I eat enough, or one when I try to make sure I don't eat too much. I've had both paid in the past and free generally. Both are great.

I've been using this app since 2010. The macros aren't even correct lol. Yet another company that probably has record profits and qualitative decline to the point of their product being unusable. Like I'm at sub 100g carbs today, and it keeps showing me over my allotment. Does using this app add calories now? The UI, like so many products, is downright unfriendly and nonsensical. Way to go, yall played yourselves. Goodbye and good riddance.

I’ve been using MFP premium for years. The recent update ruined the app. Go back to seeing all your logged meals on the first screen - the extra step is useless. Can’t see my macros remaining as I edit my pre tracked day. And can’t edit multiple items at the same time… Did you even test this before you released it?

I've been using this app almost daily for 10 years, but this new app update has ruined this app. I'm now actively searching for a replacement. I can't see all my meals at once, creating a problem of items being missed or logged incorrectly. The macros at the top is nice, but if I can't see if my meals are logged correctly or how many calories I have left, it's useless. Why change the front interface screen to make it HARDER to log meals? I've never seen so much joint outrage for something.

I've been using MFP for a decade and with the exception of a few occasional bugs, it was easy to use and did what I needed, which was log my food and aggregate my nutrition. The new UI is so clunky and unintuitive. It takes a lot more clicks to log food and edit your food diary. At the end of the day when I'm trying to dial in my last snack, I have to click back and forth into and back out of the meal to see my total calories and macros. It's awful. And I'm very annoyed I just paid for a year.
With the recent update most of the nutritional info has disappeared. That level of detail is the value add that Firness Pal previously provided.

The new update is awful! I hate the layout of the new diary, it's too big yet shows less than the last version. It's too hard to see your daily food choice progress. I loved how you could focus on how well you were doing that day, using the blue curved tracker. It's harder to clearly track protein/fiber/calories. All around, dislike the entire app layout now. I've used MFP for years and I hate to say it but I'm thinking of trying out a different app. I used to recommend it, not anymore sadly.

I’ve tried really hard to get used to the new user interface and give it a good shot, but I am really not liking it AT ALL. The info is spread too far out and it’s not as easy to just quickly see the day, things are moved and logging is way more complicated. It just seemed like an unnecessary change, the other layout seemed fine??? I have no idea what the reason for this change is but it real makes NO sense, it was not needed.

reviews.t: Use to be the best, but not now
reviews.x: This app use to be the GOAT off calorie counting apps. It was simplistic, showed my workouts and was easy to navigate but now it sucks. This new update is the worst. I hope they change it back.

The April update ruined the app, which I’ve been using for 10+ years. Among many complaints, it is very annoying to not be able to see all of your food entries for the day when you go to the diary page. I will be switching to another app because of this

Do not like the new format. Trying to find some of the older features are gone or no longer offered with the basic subscription. Yes the food logging is right there to remind you but being able to adjust the home page was nice as users could decide what is important to them. If it's not broke, don't fix it to something worse.
I really miss the old format … where you can see all your meal items under their categories e.i.. breakfast, lunch, dinner ….this one sucks…

This isn't just a calorie counter, it's the way to track & balance an eating plan. When I can see what nutrients I eat, I'm motivated to eat the right foods...not empty calories. I've been using this app for almost 5 months, with great results for my health! 5/26 review: I updated the app & I'm quite disappointed. In the old version, it was easy to see everything at a glance -- logged foods, goal percentages, etc. Now everything is harder to find. Less user friendly. Down from 5 stars to 2.

Tells me my username is taken, it hasn’t even asked me to make a username and won’t let me see or change what ever it says the username is. It won’t even tell me what the username is that it says is taken

Previously I rated the app 5 stars and have been using it happily for years. However, the current bug of the app not syncing with the online version is beyond frustrating! The web version is what syncs to other tracking platforms, and so I've been forced to switch to this instead of using the app. Searching for food on the website is frustrating, it's poorly set up for use on mobile and trying to add new foods can sometimes fail. Please fix this. It's been at least a month now!
This new update is terrible, all the convenient functions are gone and it’s terribly time consuming to use. If they don’t bring back the features I would look for other better options

I used this app for years. It was affordable and easy to use and kept me on track. However in the past couple years they changed it so much it was harder to navigate and the premium price tripled . So I’ve gone to a better calorie tracker for half the price.

I'm joining the chorus of people complaining about the new interface. If you want to see what you ate, you now have to access each meal individually (or access the list with one extra, useless tap) because all it shows is one item + x more instead of the full list like before. No one asked for this. It's just making things more tedious for no reason. I don't mind the other changes so much but PLEASE, let me see the full list at a glance.

before the latest update, the app was very useful. there were issues, but at least it was useful. post update... almost completely useless. very hard to find the chart with my weight. unable to easily see my calorie usage for the day. doesn't show me exercise calories. entering food is very cumbersome. will be using this app a whole lot less. considering removing.

Please go back to the old interface, or at least go back to what was working. This new interface is horrible, I don’t see the information I’m looking for when I open it. It’s not helpful at all. I’ve used this app for years, and every day for the last eight months. And I hate the new interface.
Works well

I'm editing my review. I've been using this app for about 2 weeks and I've been impressed with how much they have in their food data base. It be great if they had different options for premium . As of now it's 19.99 monthly or 79.99 yearly. both seem a little steep for a trial run . 29.99 for 3 months would be nice doable median . even if it was only allowed once. More people could try it and perhaps get more future user's. because as of now ,20 bucks is just too much money to try something

During the brief periods between glitches and malfunctions it is okay. However, there persists regular system glitches: saved foods and meals disappearing or getting multiplied 20+ times in the list. Currently deleting certain foods from saved meals list daily, not transferring calories for some foods, cannot enter new foods due to unit of measurement not working. These types of glitches are a regular part of using this app. The highest absurdity is that they expect you to pay for it.

App no longer finds the foods being searched for - even though they have been in my foods list for several months. This last update was horrific and now I cannot track properly because my foods are gone and the app doesn't find them in the All Foods section either, but asks me if I want add a food. NO I don't want add a food, that's what I use this app for!!! Go back to the previous system before this horrible update. Ya didn't have to fix something that wasn't broken.

Long time user: This new update's UI makes nearly every aspect of the display and logging worse. You can't see all the logged items at once unless you click on the day specifically. Can't swipe to different days anymore. Annoyingly located pop-up under meals to copy meals from different days, which when accidentally clicked, has to be deleted individually. The summary dashboard is less easily digestible. I recommend finding an alternative food tracker at this point.
App use to be so easy to navigate. Now the UI sucks. Overly complicated for no reason and clunky
I will not be renewing my membership I hate the new update. I like it the way it was now I’m done with it

The latest version is terrible to use. Requires way too many adjustments to meals that were much simpler, and quicker, before. Which I used for a number of years. Can no longer change time for groups of food at one time, doesn't copy to other days at same time, and too many back buttons to get an overall view of changes. I am not pleased with this update and would prefer the previous view. If this isn't corrected, I may look at a different app. Poorly executed update MtFitnessPal.
Loved the app until the latest update. Would give 5 stars if it was changed back.
Horrible to start charging people to scan their meals after all this time. Deleting the app immediately after the update.

I dont understand what happened? was there an update? because I had been logging food just fine for years and now it can't find a single food I type in.. kind of rendering the app useless. guess I'll be looking for another app to use to track. update: the issue has been fixed. changed my rating but still not 5 star. when I first started using this app I was able to scan barcodes. it sucks to watch greed takeover and see apps make what used to be free features something you now pay for.

This works okay, but ever since they moved the food scan option behind the "premium" paywall the service seems to be less consistent or user-friendly And why this new design?? It's more complicated to navigate, harder to select only certain foods or food groups to copy or share and there is no clear breakdown at the top of the calorie goal, how much has been used, how much earned through activity and what remains for the day. Or it's not as readily visible.

At first it was tricky to set up the definitions to get data from other sources, but it started to work well. Now, it’s a mess. Capturing activity and exercise data takes ages, it deletes data for no reason, and it duplicates, triples, and even quadruples meal entries on the same day and on previous days. I’ve spent hours deleting duplicate entries across 67 days out of the 72 I’ve been using the app. If these errors aren’t fixed, I won’t be renewing the subscription.
Clearly whoever designed this doesn’t use MyFitnessPal for logging meals. Absolute horrible update going to find a different app.

Despite the fact that scanning disappeared from the free version, I kept the app because I liked the layout better than others. However, the latest update is horrendous. I want to see the entire list of food that I've eaten for a day. I don't want to click on a meal to see it by scrolling through like I used to be able to do. I also liked having the exercise list at the bottom of the food diary. The layout is no longer intuitive. I believe I'll be switching to a different app.

New update is worse, I’m so annoyed!!!! This one at a time thing is really irritating… and copying it into 5 different slots from the day before is silly because I’d rather see the thing I’m copying and push it to the date vs start from blank and try to remember which one I’m copying from blindly
Go back to how it used to be. It’s so much harder to see all your meals now you have to click 10 things just to see your food. It was so much better before.
I found this app fantastic and incredibly helpful in keeping track and staying on track. I have built a bit of a database of foods and meals, and as a home cook, it’s made my life so much waisted.

The new version of the app is a step backwards in my opinion. You can no longer move foods from one meal to another on the same day, the exercise section provides less information - it used to show you which app the info had come from (i.e. strava or garmin) but no longer does - and you can no longer see all your foods for the day in one list - you now have to go into one meal then come out of it and go into another meal to see individual foods. This has made the app much less user friendly.

I’ve been using the app for over 10 years. One day it logs me out and complete erases my account and email, forcing me to start over with the SAME email, losing all progress, recipes, etc. Fast forward to previous couple weeks, they decided to complete change the UI and it somehow still looks like it’s from 2010, how is that even possible?! Then they add a feature to swipe to copy previous meals, awesome! Then suddenly the function is gone. It’s just so outdated and old and so many better apps out there to move to. After they deleted my info and completed changed the app to look worse, more difficult to log, and ads running left and right, this is now the exact reason why myself and our friend group are switch to their competitor apps, if u can even call them a competitor 😂
This new layout is first of all very obvious used by Ali and it’s horrible. At least let us have the option to go back instead of forcing Ai slop on us

The app no longer lets you use the scanner for free and you have to upgrade to premium and pay if you want to use it. It’s disappointing how greedy a company can be for money. I used to love the app and it helped me during my weight loss journey. Now finding out I have to pay to scan is ridiculous. Allow users to use the scanner for free again!

Before the update this was extremely user friendly, now no more swiping to the next day, so many more actions required to achieve what used to be so simple where I never had an issue when needing to enter details, now I put off entering anything because if the work involved, my steps no longer sync from Garmin, that's a massive issue for me, I no longer rely on this for my calorie input/output, I'm actively looking elsewhere now, this has become too much like hard work.

Current release seems to have messed up a huge amount of my previous logging. I just saw on their website that the Android app isn't syncing with the website, but the app doesn't give you a warning. a lot of my previously logged meals now have recipes that clearly have calorie values but are entering zeros as those values. Online, it looks like much of my previously logged data has duplicate entries for every item. I don't know what happened and if they can fix this.

New UI is clunky and not compact. Taken out the feature where you can move a recipe via press hold. Now you have to go into the item menu to change it. And I liked seeing my default calorie goal. Now expenditure is calculated into your calorie intake just like Fitbit app, absolutely hate it. New bug: Recipe changes are not saved, tried clearing cache.

reviews.t: PLEASE FIX GLITCH IN NEW UPDATE - NUMBER OF SERVINGS
reviews.x: Please fix the custom recipie glitch where when you create a recipie, if you try to select the number of servings AFTER serving size it takes up the entire iPhone screen and you have to crash the app and restart. (iPhone SE 2nd generation) This happened in the big update April 2026.

Edit#3. I've had to come back and change my review after a series of updates that introduced new 'features'. The last bugs were surmountable but this latest complete overhaul of the interface is absolutely hateful. if anything is going to break my 10 year streak and try teamrh instead then it might be this, I'll give it a while to see if I can get used to it or find an older version but I doubt either of those would work.
Horrible update. Makes it so I can’t customize anything anymore, including what day to start my tracking and easily see how many calories are left.

A truly abysmal step backwards for the user interface/experience. The full day used to be on a single page, the moment you opened the app. Input your food for each meal, scroll down for next meal, swipe between days. For some godforsaken reason, you now have to navigate through separate sub-menus for each meal, then exit sub-menus and scroll to the top, and change the day from a calendar. New users: from someone who's used the app for over 10 years, I recommend what I'm doing - find another app

I can't imagine the person who green-lit this update uses the app, because absolutely ruined its functionality. Figuring out what I've logged is profoundly cumbersome now that it requires a separate click to see each meal. I routinely have 10+ entries in a meal, and the inability to alter their order of appearance makes it more difficult to confirm I've entered everything correctly and haven't double-counted. Glad I found a way to revert to an older version, because the new one is garbage.
I dunno who’s idea it was to change the interface, but it is so much more complicated to register my calories since the latest update

This new update has seriously messed with something backend for the data base connection. I cannot log any foods without creating a new one or having to sign out and log back into the app. Please fix, it is extremely frustrating to have a majority of the app just not work correctly. (Edit) No, it was not a meal logging issue. it seemed to be an app issue along with, why cant I delete meals???? Like. I have a bunch I either messed up portions or just dont use anymore but they now just sit there.

the look in the newest update is TERRIBLE. it still 'works' but I may stop using it to find something better. The day completed button is hard to find. if you have 'fat fingers' it is too easy to hit copy meal on the main screen. The total calories available on the main screen is harder to view, adding water is too many touches compared to what it was, and the comment before you add water of 'you must be thristy' is undeeded. You show steps, but this is inaccurate as you cannot manually enter

SO ANNOYED! I started using the free version of the app 8 weeks ago as I started a bootcamp. Things were going okay, then today the app logged me out. When I logged back in, ALL of my entries for the past 8 weeks have gone wrong. Some days the app has recorded me having 52,000 calories! Others 6, or 8,000! The app has added foods to days I certainly didn't eat them, or doubled, quadrupled or even more! Utterly useless 👎🏼🤬

Not a fan of the new update. Getting to my nutrition page takes extra clicks, why? This is 90% of what I'm paying for. Also I don't want to see the food I've previously logged under each meal, especially when that food was junk food, it's reminding me of food I'd rather be eating. I can't see the point of any of these changes

Edit: CAN'T LOGIN! Protein total for the day is different in 3 different places now. I can't seem to be able to delete or copy individual or multiple selected foods to other days anymore... this makes the app basically useless to me now! Also, the most recently edited foods no longer go to the bottom of a meal, which makes them hard to find. Only improvement is the ability to copy more than 2 days forward/backward
Bring back the old version!
Here’s hoping they roll it back. Not sure the idea behind it but everything is now harder to do and less intuitive.

I've used this app for almost ten years, and I've slowly watched it deteriorate into garbage. I dealt with not being able to scan food anymore. I've also dealt with what seems to be an issue with steps/calories getting logged incorrectly from Samsung Health. But now with the new, terrible UI update, and with what appears to be a bug that's causing sync issues and has wiped my food logs, I don't think I can deal with it anymore. It's way too much of a hassle and not worth the headache.

After the update, my calories keep randomly changing across months of tracking. The help desk just said that I had to delete the incorrect ones manually but that's almost impossible considering how many they are! my daily calorie totals are also wrong. I've been a MyfitnessPal user for over 5 years, premium for most of that, and I would have continued a lot longer if it wasn't now plagued with bugs.

reviews.t: Terrible Update and use of AI
reviews.x: I’m extremely disappointed in the recent update that completely changed the interface and layout of the app. While change can be good, this is not. Not sure why you made these changes when there weren’t any issues before. My yearly subscription is ending soon and I can’t see myself renewing. I’m also not pleased with your decision to use AI so prevalent. I don’t think I need to explain the detriments. At the very least give the option to turn off and remove from dashboard.

This latest update completely ruins what used to be a simple, efficient experience. The UI feels like a step backwards in every way. What used to take one tap now takes two or three, and nothing feels intuitive anymore. The food diary isn’t fully visible at a glance, forcing you to click through multiple layers just to see your day. Even basic functionality like swiping between days is gone, which makes tracking feel unnecessarily clunky. Managing entries has become frustrating too. Deleting ingredients now has to be done one by one, and moving or copying food items which used to be quick and seamless is now a mess. On top of that, premium barely feels worth it anymore. Aside from removing ads and the barcode scanner, there’s little value left. If I could give this 0 stars, I would.

Have used this app for years, I’ll be closing my account and moving to a competitor. The new interface is so difficult to use and read. It has broken all the key features up and what use to take 1 swipe now takes 3-4 clicks, and it’s overall complicated.
So many things were fine before but you changed it so much. Requires unnecessary extra taps
New interface is unusable and horrible

I have used this app for years but the new update that occurred mid April 2026 is terrible to the point where I'm deleting it. It's not "oh it's new and I have to get used to it." No, they've made substantial changes that make it so unfriendly to use. I am now clicking more & more just to add my food & water intake. They use grey font on black background, it's hard to see your net calories total due to this. They separated breakfast, lunch, etc- you don't have access to all the info on one page.

I’ve been using this app for over a decade and I’m very disappointed with the new look. Yes, MFP was long overdue for a new design, but the changes make it less functional and ruin what users loved about it. I hate that I can’t view my entire day AND see the calorie breakdown (it’s displayed on the meal level or on the overview level where you can’t see individual items). I hate that there isn’t an overall setting to turn off tracking the time of the meal (you have to do it item by item). I hate that you can’t copy individual items to other days or meals. (you have to copy the entire meal). You used to be able to check off multiple items from throughout the day and copy or delete them. The new app takes longer to log food and is harder to visually see everything logged within the same day. I really wish there was an option to switch back to the old, simplified UI. Please make some changes to the features!

The new update to MyFitnessPal is not as user-friendly as the previous version. The one thing I like....the the food diary screen is the default. The log vs. +symbol... to make an entry is confusing. I know there is a learning curve, but the older version only needed a few tweaks, not an overhaul.

EDIT: the new UI update has spoiled this app. What were you thinking, guys? It was clear and easy to use, now unclear and clunky, with meal items hidden and the font sizing too samey for any at-a-glance assessment. From 5 stars to 3 - please restore it. PREVIOUS: The food diary is great and the database has all foods including a huge number of branded ones. A great way to keep track of your intake. Plus little videos of healthy recipes and helpful tips. Really well thought through.
Super application! Plein de produits français, le code barre fonctionne à merveille, un véritable coup de cœur.
The “update” has made the app clunky and it freezes. This app was never great but now it really sucks.

The new update is a bit disappointing. No more bulk delete food items, have to go one by one. Cant move items from breakfast to lunch or dinner or to another date. The only feature it really need was to log food in atleast a whole week ahead for meal preppers. I prefer the older version but with 7 days options to move to, copy to. Not 3 days.

The most recent update is terrible! The ‘swipe right’ to add or delete a meal doesn’t work. The app looks pretty but that’s about it Also can no longer see the impact of calories burned during exercise. The older version was better.
App hasn’t opened all day, everything else works. Tried deleting and redownloading twice.

Mostly good, and far better than the popular alternatives. Two annoying problems. The Diary doesn't show the items in the accurate order anymore, which makes it hard to check if I entered them correctly. Also, if I open the app and search a food, about half the time, before I finish logging it, the app randomly takes me back to the main screen (with "Today" at the top) and I have to start again, which is frustrating and adds friction to the action that should be the easiest.
The newest update took away key diary viewing features I use every day such as a quick view of sodium, potassium, and fibre per food. Absolutely ruins the experience based on my goals.

I can't believe what a horrible job MFP did with the UI redesign. All in the name of AI? It's people who use your app, not AI! People who struggle with weight already have a hard time logging their food and you just made it harder by adding additional clicks and navigation to log or see anything. Wtaf were you thinking?! The whole point of UI is to make it more efficient and intuative for the user, not to serve AI. Figure out how to integrate without sacrificing the user experience! Braindead!
Once you get into the habit of logging in it becomes automatic helping me stay accountable and lose weight thank you !

Stop deleting my reviews. This is the fourth time. The new UI really disrupts my workflow. I often adjust the quantity of a food item to hit my macros. Now this requires me tapping a meal, tapping the item, tapping back, and scrolling up to the top to see the total macros for the day, and repeat. It's much more clunky and cumbersome now with no apparent benefit.
Not much more can say. Long long long time user. The title says it all.
If I could give this a negative star I would. Terrible update that makes you do more to get less. They have taken a decent app and made it difficult to use cumbersome to navigate. Awful.

I'm a premium user & really enjoyed this app when I started using it in 2013. Simple, everything on the home screen & easy to view, especially foods eaten & weight (the two most important things). There have been some updates over the years, but the most recent one was disappointing. Can't view all foods eaten w/o multiple clicks, weight is hidden way at bottom, overall much less user friendly. Feels like they're moving away from its original purpose. Not sure I'll keep using this app.

I don't normally leave app reviews but the last update has made the app so much harder to use. Everything takes more clicks to get to the same places as it did before. You also can't see what you've eaten for your meals at a glance without having to open each, where as before you could swipe between days and see at a glance. Now you can't swipe between days. Logging water intake it's now multiple clicks too and so is looking at your nutrients. It's far less user friendly than before

reviews.t: Not a fan of the latest version
reviews.x: I was looking forward to the new update, however quite disappointed. Select the current time is not working appropriately, selecting random times there are never log. Copy or copy from function also does not work unlike the previous version where it was copying times of the previous day it brings everything into a lump sum at a time that is completely random. The edit portion of the app, which could select several different elements of your meals and erase them or copy them as all disappeared so when everything is copied as a lump sum, trying to erase everything is taking some time choosing things one by one. In all, you have a lot of work to do to bring this app to the Level it was before

update: the new update is absolutely trash and it's worse now than it ever was. I love the concept of this app. I've used it for years. I had the free premium trial because I did enjoy the barcode scanner... but now almost everything I've scanned has had incorrect information. Why pay for something that doesn't work even half the time? I will continue using the free app for now, but I can't justify the premium price for the barcode scanner if all the nutritional info rarely matches.
This new update made everything busier and less intuitive.

I’ve used this app for years and this new update has made me consider leaving this app. Used to easily see your whole day of foods nicely laid out and you could remove all foods from a meal in 2 clicks. Now you have to remove each ingredient individually. Hard to switch days , hard to see my macros sets. Just completely ruined the app

No barcode scanner anymore without premium plan (UK based). I'm not paying £15 a month for a barcode scanner, there are alternative much cheaper or free platforms I can use with a barcode scanner. New update is awful and experiencing issues with the database recently. Me and my partner diary share which we can't do anymore, we've deleted and created new accounts which works for a day or two and then stops working again. Deleted my account and I'll be finding an alternative.
Too much advertising

Latest update (that nobody asked for) makes the free experience of tracking your food worse - you used to be able to turn the device sideways and see a table of each food entry and its contributions to your carb fat and protein goals. Gone, for no reason whatsoever. I bet you can get it back if you subscribe tho right? Greedy company.

reviews.t: Good App but this latest update makes it more difficult to use
reviews.x: I’ve used this app for years. The new update makes it harder to move foods or even delete whole meals. Please bring back some of the older features, I miss them!!

What has always been great about MyFitnessPal and that differentiates it in the industry is the simplicity of the user experience. I have loved this app over the years as it was straightforward and efficient. Now, I find information is in too many places and it is difficult to see all of your food in one place. For future updates, I would like a greater ability to configure settings to allow different views. If users like the new update, that’s great, but there should be an option for users to view data in the same way as before.

reviews.t: New UI is horrible, find another app, this one is dead
reviews.x: This app is dead. The new UI is absolutely awful. They took away everything that made the app good. Find something else.

The app was so easy to navigate before, but this latest update version is overly complicated. What was one click away is now 2 or 3, why. I want to add my food quickly not sit going back and forth 10 times. I don’t like the new update.

I’m not happy with the new update. The new platform doesn’t allow you to edit the food that you’ve put in. You have to zero it out and leave it in the log even though it’s not there you can’t review everything that you’ve eaten on one glance you have to open each meal the older version was better

I'm joining the club on this latest update being bad. My daily calories randomly changed, allowing me 500 extra calories out of nowhere for the same targets I had pre-update. That doesn't make any sense at all and will likely give people improper results, which would be extremely frustrating if you're relying on the app to help you with your weight goals. Interface is bloated and difficult to navigate. Hopefully it gets revamped or reverted back soon!

I've been using this app since 2012, however I'm not satisfied with the new user interface with the latest update. I can no longer see all my diary entries for the day on a single pages, I have to tap into each meal. There are now too many steps to log food and exercise. I don't want to see things like water and steps on the main diary pages but I don't have the option to edit the content of the page. I cant easily switch days by swiping left and right but have to select a date from a calendar.

I’ve been using this app for years and have recommended it to any I talk to who want to track their food and exercise. The update essentially ruined the ease of the app for me. Had the joy of only being able to talk to an AI chat and be told to bad so sad

I’ve been a premium user for a couple years and loved how easy the app was to use. All food on one page for each day, not split into 4 cards that are hard to read and don’t show everything anyway. That’s just one thing…. Anyway going to try and get a refund for having just paid for premium or otherwise eat the cost because this UI/UX is so bad it makes me not want to track, which defeats the whole purpose of having a tracking app!!!!! Not happy. Clearly with all the backlash, the designers/devs should consider all the feedback and make a meaningful change even if it can’t be reverted.

I have a theory about apps, and many other things, the people in charge can’t help themselves- they improve something until they ruin it. It’s happened here. I am slightly grateful since this latest ‘improvement’ is motivating me to look for a different app and cancel my subscription to this one. A great development is that one can move on. There are other choices.

Spent 2 months diligently tracking my food in, my exercise, daily updates done. I opened the app to log my breakfast, it made me log back in and reset my password and all my data is lost. The help support said there was nothing they could do.

The new update is huge step backwards. Way too many clicks to do simple logging (even water), no daily overview without more clicks, exercise (calories out) is completely separate from calories in. Android users cannot view or post in Community Forums in app, just get a blank screen. Today I realized the food and exercise I logged yesterday just disappeared, like it never happened. 10 year MFP user here.

reviews.t: Don’t like the new UI update :(
reviews.x: New UI update is really bad. I understand it was old but it really was perfect the way it was. It was the original and the best. Did not need to change. Please revert!!!

The latest UI update is awful. It takes more scrolling and taps to get the same work done now and it is so painfully slow now. Not impressed at all. It has become an absolute nightmare and struggle to work with this app for the last few days.

The new update is awful. They absolutely ruined the platform. I don’t even want to use it anymore cause I get so frustrated everytime I try. Nothing is logical or smooth. They removed my ability to have specific calories on specific meals which is messing up my tracking and planning. There was nothing wrong! Why fix was isn’t broke!
The new version is complicated to use, requiring navigation through multiple screens to access information available in the previous dashboard. The old version was much better; bring it back.

I use the premium version so I have access to all nutrition information. I love the fasting timer. Really helps to keep consistent. Con: I can no longer sync my steps from my samsung watch. It is frustrating but, I did create a work rough work around. It's probably not accurate but I do what I can. edit- and now I am deleting this app. I can't get logged in and this not the first, second, or third time.

I was annoyed with MFP because I feel like their barcode scan feature got worse after they started charging for it, but the newest update is garbage. I miss having a separate diary, it's harder to navigate between days and individual food items logged are now in giant bubbles of their own that take up way too much space and means you have to scroll instead of seeing it all at once. Also hate that you have to click around to find some features that used to be separately labeled in the diary.

previous versions were better. they updated the food log and made it so there are more buttons to click and screens to go through to get to where you wanted. instead of being able to add food from the first screen you have to click to 2-3 screens later. the food suggestions tries to be smarter, but is worse. it's supposed to filter by recent or most used and foods that i used 2 days prior don't show up as an option.

Update: provided feedback to their support and got a 'read our FAQ' response. The app is trash. Download Cronometer instead, other MFP users are moving to there. Wow way to ruin your app with the latest update. The calorie/fat/protein trackers are so small you can't even notice if you're making progress. Also, having to click on a meal to now see what you log in your diary, and then having to scroll the list several times just makes it more labour intensive to use this app.

This version, 26.14.0, is absolutely TERRIBLE! If this had been the version when I had the choice to sign up for a premium account, I would NOT have signed up. It's so bad I wish I was paying a monthly fee so I could cancel my account. It makes me wonder if the person in-charge of the update even uses the app? Because the changes did NOT make the app better, it made it WORSE! My biggest issue with the app is that there is no way to copy a few items from one day to the next. I have to now co

2026 - They've somehow managed to make things even worse and more unaccessible. 2 stars. --- 2019 - Been using it for years, but my love for it has declined (from 5 stars to 3) due to numerous server issues and syncing issues MyFitnessPal keeps having. It's especially frustrating for a paying customer (no longer), because my money is wasted if I'm unable to use the app.

Not a fan of the new UI. Need to be able to swipe from day to day instead of swipe up and click the day. Also need to see the full day and add to breakfast, lunch or dinner without having to click into the individual meal. A full day overview that you can add to any meal was so more user friendly than having all the extra clicks/taps
Hate the update

Edit: I am deducting one star for the canned response from MFP. The app now receives a one star rating. The April changes to the UI are bad. I don't want to see macros. They are forced visible. I always fail the macros on low carb but I eat 1500 calories a day and I'm doing alright. Data entry per meal is more cumbersome. Seeing one day of diet information is not the default. Everything seems to take more clicks to accomplish. Everything else everyone else mentioned.

What the hell?!? This new update is actually the worst. Don’t try to fix something that ain’t broke. I’ve used MFP for YEARS and now I absolutely hate this new layout and user interface. It’s harder to log your food and view your diary now. And I actually hate how the daily cals show up now. It used to show your daily calorie goal, intake, burn and remaining cals right at the top of the page - quick and easy reference. Now you have to click through separate sections to see anything! It’s terrible! Now I have to find a different tracking app.

The new update is awful. It’s so many more clicks to log food. Difficult to switch to a different day vs previously you could easily swipe. More clicks to get to your nutrition dashboard. Been using MFP for years, and this update lost so many quick tricks that it made me go look at different apps, considering switching to macro factor now.

April '26 - the update is over complicated. Now missing key features I used in every entry, all used to be in the diary page and now scattered in multiple tabs. In addition to the normal 3 macros, I kept tabs on my fibre intake which I had set up on the dashboard along with the macros, and when you flipped your phone you could also view other important nutrition. Can't now. I loved having the nutritional pie atop the diary page with macros percentages. It's now gone. It was perfect before!
The old version was much easier to use. This version sucks. Harder to use, have to dig to find any nutrition or macros. Currently looking for a new tracker

The new look of the app wants to be nice, clean, fresh… but it’s actually a nightmare. I wish you still had the chance to customize the dashboard so you can keep track of your macros without losing track of your fiber and sugar intake (which are also important to me). Also, why are my calorie and macros goals hidden every time I log foods? I have to go back and forth when adjusting my meals to make sure I’m not missing/going over my set numbers. Do better!

I’ve been using this app for 10 years. Not joking. I have a 3900 day streak. There have been several updates over the years which has slightly changed the app overtime, which always has taken some adjusting to get used to. However, this new update makes MFP now unusable to me. I CAN’T COPY ENTIRE DAYS MEALS ONTO ANOTHER ONE. I HAVE TO GO THROUGH SEVERAL SCREENS TO FIND WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR. EACH MEAL DOESN’T HAVE A SUMMARY OF CALORIES. THIS IS A MAJOR MAJOR STEP BACKWARDS. VERY DISAPPOINTING AS THIS IS MY NUMBER ONE MOST USED APP. I’M NOW GONNA HAVE TO SWITCH TO MACRO FACTOR OR CRONO. TRULY UNBELIEVABLE.

The most recent update has been very frustrating. 1)Can't see total calories by meal, 2)can no longer conveniently see the entire formula that computes remaining calories, 3)On the calories chart there is no option for 7 rolling days, 4)cannot delete more than one item at a time, 5)on the Today tab, it is visually difficult to see at a glance which meals I've logged as each meal has the option to copy prior meals.I've been on this app for over 5 years and it keeps getting worse with each update.
Super counter intuitive and ugly. Stop changing stuff that works.
Was the new UI vibe coded? It’s complete trash and unusable.

I’m not sure what happened, but somehow the app signed me up for an annual plan that costs around $150. This was extremely frustrating and stressful. In my experience, this is one of the worst, most unsafe, and most disappointing apps I have used. I did not feel comfortable with the process at all, and I would not recommend it.

I hate the new layout, I have been using this app for years and loved the old version.. so I am so confused every time I use the app. Why can’t I see how many calories I’ve eaten and burned on the same screen anymore? I have to click on exercise and count them up myself now and then go back to the main page? Pointless. And now every time I was to add an exercise, I have to click more buttons… I used this app for easy and quick tracking to maintain my weight loss, this is bringing me unnecessary frustration. Nobody asked for this layout.. an improvement would have been awesome but this is a complete downgrade, please at least give us an option to revert to the old format like Outlook does.

reviews.t: I don’t mind the mew update
reviews.x: At first I didn’t like it buts it’s not bad

editing my previous 5 star review to 1 star. the new update and user interface is horrible and frustrating. you used to be able to see all of your meals for the day on one screen, and now you have to click into each meal to see it. copying meals used to be easy and now takes several pointless clicks. it's the same for erasing meals. you can no longer see the nutrition/macros page from your diary page. I'll be switching to a different meal tracking app unless mfp reverts course.
One of the worst updates I’ve ever seen. Made a wonderful app almost unusable.

Was a really good app, but they changed it just to change it and now nothing is intuitive. You can accidentally add all the logged foods from a previous day to a meal with one tap, which you then have to delete 1 by 1. Calories remaining is so small, you have to squint to read. you can't see everything in 1 day anymore, you have to tap individual meals and then go back to see calories logged. so clunky now.

This needs to be rolled back!!! Why can’t I see calories for breakfast/ lunch and dinner on the main screen without going into each of them. No improvement with this update, opposite. Old version was way better.

I'm changing my original 5-star rating in 2015 to 3 stars in 2026. Until this week, I loved the app, but now the design is awful. Before, I could see all calorie and food intake in one screen. At the top was the day's calorie allotment, how many I'd eaten, how many I used in exercise and how many I had left. Below that was my food log showing everything I'd eaten, water intake and exercise. Now I have to go to different screens to find the info. The old design was much easier and quicker to use.

Randomly updated out of the blue to where it was so confusing/impossible to use. Majority of the time I would add recipes and meals and it would track as 0 calories. So I refreshed the app thinking something was wrong and was rn I reopened the app, it had deleted all of my food and meals I had planned for the last two years straight. 2 years and 100lbs of data lost because they are trying to squeeze a few bucks out of my wallet to get premium, with this update. Disgusting.

The recent update is simply dire. I've read the various reviews of the latest version and the responses from MFP. I've been a user for around 13 years, but the new version should simply never have happened. Seeing your meals on a day to day basis has become unbearably opaque. Just revert to the old version and pretend you never screwed it up like this.
The new update sucksssss, wish there was a way to go back. Total jump-scare this morning when I went to log my breakfast.

MFP changed their user interface completely. It used to be user friendly and now it's so hard to track anything, find out what you ate, and hard to track your micronutrients like fiber. Check reddit and MFP threads. Don't get it until you know it's been fixed. Certainly don't upgrade to Premium hoping it will be better. That was helpful at first but now they've added so much extra stuff to make it "fancier" but it's absolute garbage now. I will be looking for another app and cancelling premium.
The new update on the app is terrible. You cannot look at all the foods you’ve eaten in one day while looking at how many macros you have left in a day to figure out what to eat

The latest update is just rubbish. it's not easy to see which day you're logging the meals for, what you logged already. I so much preferred the previous version, where everything was so much more transparent and easy to follow. I considered stopping logging because it's just a big chaos, double checking dates, synched activities, meals etc. I don't know who came up with this version but they're definitely not logging their meals. Unusable zero star

Archaic interface and unreliable. I tried a couple of calorie counters and they were excellent, quick to use and add food to. I used MyFitnessPal many years ago and it hasn't changed. Slow, clunky interface, thousands of badly entered foods, US measurements come first, their approved foods aren't reliable for nutritional values and the occasional crash makes using it a painful experience. Update: there's a new look, with an increased number of taps to log food. 🤦🏼‍♂️
I have a streak of 1288 days and this new redesign is the end of my time with MFP. Absolutely terrible app now with some AI slop redesign.

Long time user. I rarely complain about redesigns, but this new design update is horrendous. I just want to have some basic info on one screen: everything I ate that day, how many calories I've consumed, and how many I have remaining. Everything requires so many clicks now, it's so much harder to use for logging. I will likely switch to a competitor, even though I'm not happy to lose so much historical data.

I have used this app for over 12 years, paid for premium for the past 6, and this new update has made me cancel within 1 day of usage. As a nutrition professional and scientist this has become inefficient and now lacks what once made it so great. A simple, easy to navigate diary, where one can access daily logs without seven button clicks. The passive aggressive, unnecessary commentary on macronutrient intake is inappropriate and will have negative implications for those new to tracking.

Edit #2: CANCELLED. Edit: I would like a refund for remainder of the actual app I paid for. This app is now unusable with the most recent update because one can no longer see a complete day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks) as a simple list, with each of those meals listing protein, carbs, etc Not every app needs to have "card views" that require endless scrolling and actually show less information than before. Now I am out 5 months of Premium that I paid for and have basically been ripped off.

The latest update is buggy. It adds the meals properly, but shows 0 calories for most of the protein. I meal prep and most of my days are the same. It was a lot easier to copy the full day prior to the update. Now I have to do it meal by meal. Update: the app IS NOT counting the calories of the meals I had saved. it totally defeats the purpose of tracking.

reviews.t: Love the app but not the latest update
reviews.x: I love the App, have been using it forever. I don’t really like the latest update, mainly logging food. The collapsing of all the meals, ie, breakfast, lunch, dinner, etc… is a bit of a pain. I loved being able to see my meals instantly, and clicking expand kinda sucks. Instead of this for the update, can’t you just bring back the feed where you can comment on friends weight loss and reached goals?
I do not like the new update at all. I wish you would just put it back to the way it was

The new update changes the entire interface and is not intuitive AT ALL. You have to click on things more, and go to several different screens to get daily info that used to all be in one place. It’s unfathomable as to why they made this change, but after almost 6 YEARS of using MFP daily, I’m heavily considering moving on for the first time. EXTREMELY PUZZLING direction for them to take

The new update / new interface is awful! I've been using this app for more than 10yrs. Since their update all my history is gone, despite being on a 99 day streak. Even yesterday's log is gone! Too many clicks now to see your diary entries. Also no more weight projection when you complete the diary, no warning for logging under 1000 calories. Emailed support, suggested option of users having "classic view" but they said not possible. How about make sure your update works before rolling out.
New update is terrible please go back to the previous version!!!

Like everyone else who has written a review in the last few days, I dislike the latest update so much that I am on the App store looking for an alternative. I don't like the format. I hate not being to turn off the AI. I was bothered by the update before this where I lost all my body measurements except my weight. But this latest is beyond terrible. I only use the app to track my macros, nutrition, calories, weight and measurements. I don't use and don't want the other features.

reviews.t: Latest update terrible, not good user friendly
reviews.x: This latest update is so bad, I don’t know who was in charge of UX but it’s like they thought of all the worst ways it could be redesigned and then applied them all. Will likely be switching to something else now and I’ve been using this app for a decade.

There’s many things that could have been improved in the update. None of which were addressed. Instead, introduction of a terribly laid out app, confusing to navigate, extremely not user friendly. I’ve been using this app for over 10 years and it’s really a let down for them to just scrap a well working app for this. Get some new developers and listen to your audience base, we all hate it.

4/25/26 I can no longer use the app to track my foods, because after the latest update, it has a non-user friendly interface, and no longer displays the data necessary to plan my meals for the day. All I can think, is that people who don't use the app, and have never seen the prior app's layout created something out of fever dream, without consulting any of the paying users.

I'm a pro user. The new UI is visually nice but 95% of the complaints would be solved if they just put the entire diary in a single view instead of having to click into individual meals. And reimplementing basic features like moving an entry from one meal to another via long press. I don't want to have to click into the entry (especially now that it's 2 levels deep) to change what meal it's assigned to. I want to move it to another meal when I can see both meals, for planning purposes. Obv 🤦‍♂️

I was a big fan until the most recent update. All I want is to track calories. The most effective way to accomplish this goal is to see the breakdown of each item and meal quickly. I want to see the sum for the day, sum for each meal, and total for each item on the same page. This separated MFP from other calorie tracking apps. Now there is so much unnecessary clicking to see things, add things, or delete things.

Update to now 23 April 2026.. Why is it, that someone in there decides let's update to our app and stuff it up. Each update becomes less usable. You just drive away customers. This is a perfect example. You want more money. $130 for one year. What a joke. I was using this app from the beginning so it's just another one I've watched slowly decline. I'd pay a reasonable amount to just have a simplified version with just the diary and nothing else. Like it used to be

The update is awful for people who like to plan out meals and adjust portions/ selections based on calorie totals. Ex: the 'diary view' only shows that breakfast is 465 calories (each item is hidden, only 1 shows) - so you have to swipe over to 'full view' to see each ingredient & its calories ... but there's no total calories in that view. So, if my goal was to have 400 calories for breakfast, I have to adjust items in the full view page THEN go back to the diary to check the total cals.

Latest update is awful. Can't see all of my food for the day on one screen. You have to click into each meal to see every item logged. It also takes more taps to log food and water, wasting time. Can't swipe between days either. You have to tap the day from the top or pick it from a popular calendar, again taking longer to use the app especially when I'm trying to just copy a meal from a previous day. Hate it and will be looking at alternatives to switch.

They updated the app and now there is no way to delete food you entered in in error. Update: 04/25 I have tap everywhere on the app and under "today" brings up a calender. The today at the buttom just brings you back home. I do not see a way to delete food. The "log yesterday" is right under the the log button and you can easily hit it and enter the wrong food. I personally do not like this layout change.

The most recent update is horrible. I'm hoping they actually review the posts and revert back. It is no longer user friendly. You have to click so many more times to add food and then many times to go back to the main screen. It's much harder to see where you're at with your daily macros. I am planning to check if I can cancel my membership with money back and will be trying another app. It was worth paying for but I no longer feel that way.

Every time MyFitnessPal does a so-called "upgrade" it's worse. I have an Android phone and now I can't access any of the Community pages. The new food diary interface is horrendous. Save yourself a LOT aggravation and find a different app. I'm letting my Premium membership expire. Once it does, I'm gone. On the plus, side their food database is huge.

Used to love mfp, have used it since 2010. I've seen it change so much over the years, and not for the best. Function after function put behind a paywall, the loss of the barcode scanner never sat well with me but this latest update is the final straw. It's barely usable! Terrible layout, no info at a glance. I'm off to look for alternative calorie apps!

Terrible update! I used this app for over 10 years and loved it. In a matter of 3 days I deleted it and will never use again. This update is not user friendly at all, logs me out for no reason, password doesn't save, won't let me scan anything, won't give me appx weight goals. It's like you don't want anyone to use the free app. Bye.

The new update looks great, however a few things that could be better 1. I had each meal setup with a specific amount of calories. You can no longer see how many calories per meal are available until after you start logging your meal. 2. There should be a quick add for any recent meals, not only the same meal from the previous day 3. There should also be a multi-select delete option for meals. When you accidentally copy a meal from the previous day, need to delete each item individually.

I love this app. I've been using it for years with 125lbs lost. I've never had a problem until the past few months. food logs disappearing, doubling logs, inaccurate weekly calorie numbers. it's been BUGGING. I'd love the old MFP back :( I can't go through every week and readd things or remove things.

The new UI update is AWFUL. It is not intuitive to be able to log food and exercise. It visually is also a lot more difficult to view the stats for the day. And to see everything you used to is more clicks, which makes it extremely unfriendly for neurodivergent users. You can't swipe between days. Just awful. I wish there was a way to uninstall the update. Otherwise, I'm looking for another tracking app which isn't so allergic to accessibility. The old UI was perfect.

They have done it again! This latest update has made the app more useless. You now have to go through a maze to see your full day, and you don't even see calorie totals by meal anymore. A key part of managing your health (what this app USED to be about) is consistency; making wholesale changes that disrupt how people do that is absurd. The app has taken another step towards garbage. After nearly 10 years, I will be looking for a less confusing app to track my calories.

Used the app for a long time now (10 years or so off and on). Works well for tracking a lot of basics in the free version. However as time has passed more pay walls are added for features that used to be free, pop ups appear almost every time you open the app, and this most recent update made the visual navigation in my opinion far less user-friendly which is what's finally pushed me to write a review. This used to be a five star app, 3 because it still functions for basics or it'd be lower.

I'm only leaving the 2 stars because of basic functionality. The new layout with having everything on the home screen gives me a headache and isn't the big reveal you believe it is. Being able to directly access the diary and see the data right in front was much more user friendly without all the other distracting elements such as the graph at the top. I don't even recall there being this "home screen" that you're marketing. Also way too many clicks to be able to access what need.

I don't usually leave reviews, but I would like to state this update absolutely bugged my calories (UI prior was fine too). It was perfectly fine this morning and now every day I've logged has 5,000 calories in surplus. I've tried reinstalling but that didn't work-- it's permanently logged multiple entries that weren't there before. I understand I'm one frustrated out of many, many long-term users who may be fine with this, but I'm not. I'm moving onwards; good luck, MFP.

I've been using this app since 2013 and am pretty tech savvy. However this latest update is not an improvement. It's time consuming. I don't have time to individually log every food item. The ability to go to another day hit the edit & select the ones I want is gone along with the ability to do the same to delete multiple items at once. Not being able to see all my food items at a glance without clicking view all is an inconvenience. The weight added to the page is overriding every other day.

I am a 10-plus year user of this app. As if it isn't bad enough that the bar code scanner is behind a paywall, and a lot of the green checked verified foods in the search menu are often incorrect when it comes to calories and macros, you roll out this terrible update. Please consider going back to the former UI, and please consider making the barcode scanner free or you need to deep dive into the search and clean up the incorrectly verified items. I may go to another app and start over.

The latest update is absolutely horrible. This is not the MFP that's been so user friendly for a decade+. Can't even see my entire day diary in one place anymore. Everything takes a bunch of clicks and I can't just get a simple view of my day. Awful. Adding: I reached out to support Before writing this review and they weren't helpful. They basically gave a "change is hard" patronizing as hell response. I want my annual subscription that I paid last month refunded for this bait and switch!

The new layout update is perfectly designed to allow for overeating. I won't recommend it for anyone who has trouble with sticking to a calorie deficit. All details which were previously very clear and concise to help understand your patterns and food weaknesses, now are hidden away and no longer visible for clarity. I don't believe the app is catered towards identifying meaningful lifestyle changes that can help in losing weight and keeping it off.

was a great app, until the new update. the UI is horrible and not a good experience to use at all.
