I hate not seeing all the foods logged for a meal, it's hard to delete meals you've logged accidentally, the overview of calories is less legible than before - to just name a few things. I wish there was a way to choose to use the old UI.

I've had the app for over a year and loved it... Until the recent update. It seems the feature to move one food to a different meal is no longer available, you can only move the WHOLE meal contents. It takes way more clicks to move a single item now. Everything is also scaled to be too big, so I have to scroll so much more to see the amount of information that used to fit on screen.

4-24-26. The update from a few days ago sucks. Previously we could select foods to copy day to day on a select all or individual basis. if you chose select all you could individually deselect options too. This function made it a breeze to fill in each day. Now you can only copy each meal (lunch, snacks, etc). They also removed the ability to highlight a food item and move it to a different meal (i.e. from lunch to dinner) now you have to do extra steps. The point is ease and they made it harder.

Woah. The app updated and it's actually awful now. not only does it look bad and is cluttered as heck but it ruined basic features. There was a popup saying it was to put the diary front and center, but it already was??? I could see all my logged foods easily and now I have to click in to each meal to see everything. There is a giant button for logging yesterdays food today where today's foods used to actually be and I keep accidentally hitting it. No usability testing clearly.

The new update has utterly destroyed the Ui experience. Logging food takes about 5x longer and is more cumbersome having to flip through multiple pages to log things into each meal. I can no longer swipe between days, I have to open the calendar, select the day then press ok. I used to be able to log my food for a day in around a minute, by copy/pasting from day prior and tweaking things here and there. Now I have to press through like 15 different menus to do what took me seconds before.

New UI complicates adding foods, reverts back to same nutrient overview even when I change it. I need easy access to my full diary because I plan meals in advance and check to see what I'm eating. Once I get my recipes off here I'll delete the app. they responded to my review. I can use the app, it just sucks and takes a bunch of extra time for something I used to do at a glance. it's no longer functional for my needs. I meal plan on my own: I don't need AI for that.

I've been using this app for over 2 years. I use it daily and it has motivated me to lose weight by being aware of and keeping track of how many calories I'm putting into my body and how many I'm burning each day. Update: 4/24/26 I've been using this app for 10 yrs. I wasn't happy when I could no longer use the bar code reader w/out a large fee but continued to use the app. This week the app changed. It is no longer user-friendly and I don't like the changes at all. Looking for a new app. Sad.

After 20+ years of MFP, I've switched to Cronometer!!! Ooof....what a failure. New update has made the app unusable. Can't enter foods like before, can't scroll to previous days, can't easily add water, etc etc etc. I would never develop something like this for my customers. And good luck using this if you have any visual impairments. I'm going to move on to a different food tracking app. Tired of the push to pay for Premium too.

As a user for well over a decade I had to come and update my review from 5 stars to 1. I only wish it could be zero. This UI update is a complete disaster, removing functionality like swiping left & right to change days and making simple logging take more clicks than before. It is easy to accidentally tap "add yesterday's meal" (which is much larger and more central than the "log" button) forcing you to delete each item individually afterwards. Every part of the app has become painful to use.

This app was previously 5 stars from both myself and my spouse. We even upgraded to the premium subscription. When I opened the app today the format was completely changed and NOT for the better! It is almost completely unusable. So much so that if it isn't changed back we will cancel our subscriptions, delete the app, and search for a new one. Way to go, My Fitness Pal.

My phone finally forced an update through for the app and I hate it. Why, in 2026, are we going back to a drop down menu to pick days in the food diary when it's had swiping for the past 10 years or so? Having the macro totals at the top instead of rotating the phone is kind of nice, but why have the logged foods all become tiny blurbs unless you click on them? I want to see all the food nicely arranged in my meals. The app is about tracking food, and I would like to SEE that still.

I've been using this app off and on for years, it's always been reliable, until the new update. The update added so many extra steps, why when I got my nutrient and macro page does it automatically show weekly average? It makes no sense for me to have to change it to show just today, today should be default. The diary used to be very neat and easy but now there's so much extra scrolling involved. I will likely be switching to Lose It.

the most recent update for this app is terrible. there's now more things to click through to get where you want and the UI is just generally more difficult to view information. Viewing macros left for the day is also problematic, as when you go over macros there is almost no visual difference, so it's easy to miss. This app also doesn't keep previously logged foods in the history very long. I paid for premium but it's no longer a premium experience.

Been using this app for 5 yrs and this update is terrible! The layout and interface is completely different and not for the better. I have ADHD so I need to plan my meals the day before and then eat based off that, otherwise I snack too much or don't eat at all. The condensed look on the home screen makes that much more difficult. Now I have to click on each meal to see what it contains, rather than just scroll up and down to remind myself of what I need to eat in the day. Trash. Please undo.

I am extremely disappointed with the new app experience overall. It's not about "taking time to get used to", it's that the app's main focus, the food diary, has been ruined by being removed from its own tab, converted to a list of gigantic, space-consuming cards, and relegated behind a pointless "view all" button. There isn't a single time when I wouldn't want to view my entire diary at once - it's the only thing I'm interested in seeing when I open the app. At the very least, condense it!

I've been using this for several years on and off. in the last year I used it extensively to lose 90 pounds and achieve my goal weight, along with major health improvements. But what deranged lunatic came up with the recent update (3/3/2025)? This went from being intuitive and easy to use, to literally hiding the information you want behind to see. I can't see what I've logged without several clicks and the app fighting against me seeing my log. Stupid, and I'm probably deleting it! (4/23/26)

The new update brought me to review the app with a one-star rating. I see others feel the same way. Please, please, please go back to the old design. I liked the circle that showed how much exercise impacted my "calories left" for the day. I liked that calories consumed, calories burned, and calories left were all at the top and easy to see. The app doesn't seem to be syncing with GoogleFit anymore - I'm used to a lag, but now it's not registering or converting them to calories burned.

Update 4/23/26 new update makes it where the diary only shows one food you logged and says "and 4 more." No!!! I want to still see my FULL diary when I look at it. Update I'm dropping my 5 stars down to 3 for now. I've used this app for years. Just recently the search function doesn't search my existing foods and give me a matching list. I have to do a full search and choose a result to use each time.

I left a 5 star review in 2013. After using this app for over 13 years, the new update (and character limit) have forced me to replace it with a one star review. The new UI is beyond terrible. The diary used to be simple to use; now it's a nightmare. And the number of calories left for the day? No longer big bold numbers; now it's tiny numbers you have to scroll to find. Other reviews show I'm far from alone in my dislike of the changes. Way to get rid of your (formerly) faithful users.

changed the layout and it's frustrating to use. it used to show in really big numbers how many calories I have left in the day, now it shows how many calories I've already eaten with the amount I have left in tiny text. way less useful. it's already a hassle to try to keep track of all my food and now I have to struggle with an overly aesthetic less useful interface.

Used to be pretty good but made a LOT of unnecessary changes to the interface which makes it unusable. The key information isn't made clear like your calories over or under (in small pretty and greyed out) you can't delete full meals or move them now and the dashboard is useless tabs linking to premium features. To do anything you want to do, you now have to click multiple times and jump through hoops. Have now deleted the app along with countless others and moved to a competitor. Sad end.

Been using MFP for 15 years. The UI update is awful. There are so many extra steps to log water and see my nutrition breakdowns. When I click nutrients, it defaults to week view instead of day now. It's clunky, all the text is too large, and everything is hard to see and look at. I am seriously considering switching to a different macro tracking app, which is sad since I have 15 years of data.

I cannot express how awful the new update has made this app. It's like they've paid a consultant a bonus fee if they can reck it as much as possible. Shocking user experience, and the best part is there was little wrong with the older set up. It genuinely has to be AI, I refuse to believe anybody tested it and said "yeah, thats great".

I've used Myfitness Pal for years. It was always so easy to use. This latest update is horrible. It feels like using a complete new app. You can't see your whole day of meals without clicking on each individual meal. I'm seriously considering switching entirely to a different app. I understand the need to update, but why not keep some of the same features that users like and are used to.

After using this app for 4739 days, the latest "NEW MYFITNESSPAL" is a terrible change. Each item you enter doesn't stay in the order you enter it. Meal item times take on the entry time, and if you are altering the meal time, you have to edit the time for each item. It's not rocket science to know that all meal items will have been eaten at the same time. There is so much more I could complain about, but time and characters are running out. It is simply a terrible mess to a good app.

Well you guys finally did it. Ruined an app I've been using for well over a decade to the point I will have to find a replacement. I need the ability to make a customized start date for my tracking week, i.e. Friday - Thursday. This is non negotiable. It is how I manage weekend/weekday calorie averages for the week. Extremely disappointed I will now have to take time to shop around for apps that do what I need and I will lose a decade of logging data.

I've been using the App for years. the latest update is a total reverse engineer in terms of simplicity, easy of use, and far more clicks to achieve adding daily food. I don't use meal planning or guides, I know what I want to eat and enter as I go. The process is a chore now for quick click data entry. stop over thinking problems that really aren't there.

The recent update to the UI has made me go elsewhere for calorie tracking, I've been using this app for years and never had an issue. Some of these changes are minor like no longer being able to change the start of the week, considering that you used to be able to I don't understand why these kinds of things are removed. I'm not a fan of how the main page and diary have merged and the constant mistakes of adding yesterday's food because of a misclick is incredibly frustrating.

Why change the interface??? It was great, now it's rubbish, confusing, not so simple, overwhelming... Finally upgraded to pro at the start of the year and this has annoyed me!!! For something that helps such a huge range of people getting something so difficult and overwhelming under control, you've now buggered that and it feels like change for the sake of changing something. Hate it. You could've put the time into improving the barcode reader and other bits that were already there.

*update. they stuck with their plan for the update and it's bloody useless. If I could get a refund on my premium I would. I cannot see any advantage to these changes nor any improvement since the initial version I saw. I have so many recipes etc saved but tough. I'll be out. March 2026 update is awful. Too big, much less data visible at a glance, more steps to delete an entry, definitely a backward step. Will look at alternatives even though I've paid and have about 10yrs data/recipes in it.

Been using this app daily for nearly two years now and has been fantastic in helping me keep on track as I lost the weight and now maintaining that weight loss. It would be four stars but after getting the update some of the functionality like copying a whole days food log or being able to select what I want to copy across all meals in one go to the next day has been removed and this is something I use everyday to simplify the whole process.

Latest update as of Apr 23, 2026. It now requires more clicks to do anything, including adding food and copying food from another day. You can no longer simply swipe back and forth between days to copy a meal from. You have to use the top bar to select a specific date, but you dont know which day you need to pick as you cant see the meals there. Even the current day only shows you a summary of each meal. Interface is a major downgrade for usability.

This app used to be the best app for weight loss, gain, just tracking your nutrition goals in general for anyone. This app truly helped me achieve my goals and I lost 20+ lbs and looked and felt the best I ever had. Took a break from tracking then came back and noticed you had to pay to scan barcodes! Decided to go to calAI. Once my year sub ended, came back to MFP, and it's even worse. Can't even track macros correctly. Now the new layout is awful. This app fell apart. It was perfect. No more

I've been using the app for the last 2+ months and have been loving it. BUT today's update has been less than ideal. the UI feels clunkier and less intuitive. The push on the meal planning is a big detractor for me. I may want to check it out, but I don't want to be pushed. I paid a premium so I didn't get the ads. Now on to the positives, the barcode scanner and wealth of preloaded items is fantastic for busy working dad of 3. I can usually jump in and find items quickly.

I've been using MFP for a decade, no issues. The new interface/update is terrible. please change it back or give us the option to use the old interface. It's not user friendly, it isn't logging or saving the food I log, and probably more, I just don't care to find out. None of it makes sense, and is a confusing mess. I'm exhausted after solving problems all day, I don't need more puzzles to solve. I'm deleting, and downloading a different tracking app until MFP reverts back.

I hate the new updated look. It moved where the diary was so now it is harder to find and edit what foods are in there. You are also now not able to see the exact amount of calories you have burned from exercise. They also took away the button to finish the diary entry and it told you what your weight could be if you ate the same way for five weeks. Essentially they took away the diary and just turned it into the nutrition tab.

4/22 edit: really dislike the new layout, makes logging food much harder. Og: This app could be really good and worth paying for, but currently it's buggy and inconvenient. I can't view or copy from friend's diaries, and it shows my calorie goals instead of theirs when viewing their diary. You can't scroll the ingredient list when it gets too long and runs off the page.
